Beta4: console presentation

Player names are bold. Chat preserves name formatting and displays green message text over a contrasting grey background controlled by con_alpha. System events use consistent name emphasis with ordinary event text. Shader prewarm, AVFX, Voice and timer authorization provide explicit output categories, so prefix color does not depend on wording or capitalization. Normal and green glyph heights are consistent in English and Russian fonts. The public Beta4 menu excludes bot launch; OpenTDM-X is distributed separately.


Beta 3 navigation

Both main and in-game menus use a single Presets entry with four domains. Lighting separates game, AVFX-oriented and custom presets. Lighting/Visibility explain mod-dependent settings and link to related options and mod configs.

The unified preset hub.

With ui_scale 0, menus adapt after resolution changes without another vid_restart. Cvar Browser adds missing help for health ambient, highlights, sound categories and window mode.



Beta 2 interface

The modern browser adds History after Favorites; network settings add recent-server retention and automatic connection. Extra Quality adds Metallic Lustre, and floor/wall material pickers add metals. Legacy server colored text and special glyphs are restored in console and HUD while preserving Russian UTF-8.


How the Q2PRO-X menu is built

The new Guided menu is the primary Q2PRO-X interface. It does not hide capabilities in autoexec.cfg; it leads you through logical sections: visuals, HDR, AVFX, highlights, network, demos, voice, single-player experiments and mods.

The Guided menu has two content profiles: Full and Multiplayer. The Multiplayer profile opens a separate compact menu for online players, while Full provides every Q2PRO-X section. The profiles differ in content, not presentation; both belong to the same Guided menu. Most rows can be opened both from the menu and by a console command.

The complete navigation map of every page is collected in the appendix at the end of this document. It is generated from the release menu file itself, so it matches what you see in the game.

1. Two menu profiles and how to switch

The menu profile is not a visual theme; it is the size of the menu.

ProfileWhat it gives
FullEvery Q2PRO-X page without exception
MultiplayerA reduced set: the main, game and options pages are replaced with compact network pages

The reduced profile is for a player who does not want to walk past dozens of visual submenus before a match. Full access to the configuration settings is preserved.

1.2. The (X), (G) and (M) badges

The badges show the scope of a setting, not its importance:

BadgeMeaning
(X)A Q2PRO-X layer setting, local to the client
(G)A global setting: it lives across mods
(M)A mod-related setting: it can differ per game folder

Each kind of badge is disabled separately if the interface feels crowded. That does not change a setting's scope — only its caption.

1.3. Hints

The hint for one row is shown in two places: as a compact line at the bottom of the screen, and as a pop-up near the cursor after a short delay. Both are enabled separately; the delay and the pop-up background opacity are configurable.

The hint text is the variable's description from the client's built-in reference. That is why the menu hint and the description in the cvar browser always say the same thing.


2. The appearance of the menu

2.1. Visual style, font, scale and opacity

Guided menu visual style changes only the presentation of the same menu between classic and modern renderers. It does not change the profile, structure, or set of pages: Q2PRO-X 1.6 Beta 5 has no separate user-selectable Classic menu.
Menu font selects the classic bitmap font or the smooth Jost Medieval menu font.
Menu scale can be left automatic or set by hand; a separate row restores the automatic mode.
Menu autoscale fits the Guided menu to the screen while the modern visual style is selected and the scale is set to Auto.
Menu opacity changes the opacity of the background.

All of these apply immediately and need no restart.

2.2. Language

The interface language is set once in the main menu, on the Interface language row: Auto, Off (English) or On (Russian). Game menus have a row of their own that either inherits the global choice or forces English or Russian.

The interface language also decides the language of the startup intro track — see the startup intro guide for details.

2.3. Whether the menu opens at launch

The Open the menu at startup row is on by default. Turning it off leaves a fullscreen console at start; the ESC key still opens the menu.



3. The console

3.1. What the Q2PRO-X console can do

The console supports scaling, opacity, fonts and readable sizes for large displays, Unicode clipboard handling, copying with Ctrl+C, and correct Russian input.

The console is convenient for:

1. Making a quick jump with a slash command.

2. Checking diagnostics: cl_avfx_info, gl_hdr_info, version, gl_render_scale_info and others.

3. Copying a variable's description from the reference into a chat, a defect report, or your own .cfg.

3.2. Russian input and translation

Q2PRO-X solves two separate problems: safe Russian input and transliteration for the Quake II console and chat, and a separate command that translates Russian text into English before it is sent to chat.

Details about input, layouts and binds are in the controls guide.


4. Quick commands

A quick command is a short slash alias that opens a menu or an overlay, or runs a diagnostic command. Every command has an English and a Russian alias: either can be typed.

This section is generated from the release quick-command table ru_input.c. Every row is a real command you can type in the console or on the chat line. Commands: 146.

5.2. The cvar reference

The cvar reference is a live search window: it finds a variable by part of its name, shows its description, its accepted values, its source and its scope, and lets you reset the value. It is described in detail in the cvars and cvar browser guide.

5.3. The performance and budget HUD

The live HUD shows occupancy bars and the measured CPU and GPU cost of the frame, of dynamic lighting and of the enabled AVFX families. It is off by default.

It is the right tool when you need to know what exactly is expensive, instead of switching things off at random.


6. Practical scenarios

6.1. "I want a simple menu before a match"

1. Open Main menu → Options → Menu Settings.

2. Set Menu profile to Multiplayer.

3. Optionally disable the badges and the pop-up hints.

6.2. "I cannot read the captions, the font is too small"

1. Raise Menu scale, or leave it on Auto and enable Menu autoscale.

2. For the console and the HUD, use their own sizes — they are configured separately in the interface section.

6.3. "I need a specific variable and cannot remember its name"

1. Open the cvar reference from Help / about Q2PRO-X.

2. Type part of the name, or a word from the description.

3. Read the description and the accepted values right there in the window.

6.4. "The menu looks unfamiliar"

Make sure the appropriate Guided menu profile is selected: Full for every section, or Multiplayer for the compact online-play menu. For a more familiar presentation, select the classic visual style and bitmap font. This changes only the presentation of the same Guided menu, not its structure or set of pages.

Live Timers — Instances (q2prox_lit_world)

Path: Main menu → Online Play Setup → Live Item Timers → Live Timers — Instances

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionHow it works — no hidden dataHow it works — no hidden data
SectionWorld observation (PVS)World observation (PVS)
ToggleWorld observation (PVS)World observationcl_it_world_observeUse only item entities already received in the current POV's normal snapshot/PVS plus static BSP map spawns. It never reveals hidden items or starts a timer from PVS churn alone. Automatic start requires a confirmed current-POV pickup at a permanent map spawn. Applies immediately.
ToggleWorld observation (PVS)Instance ordinalscl_it_ordinalsShow the BSP ordinal (1,2,...) on the HUD when a map has more than one of that item. Applies immediately.
SectionLearning & radiiLearning & radii
ToggleLearning & radiiPer-instance learningcl_it_learnLearn a session-only interval from the SAME BSP spawn disappearing/reappearing. Dynamic Mega is excluded unless it has a fixed override. Applies immediately.
SliderLearning & radiiBSP match radiuscl_it_bsp_match_radiusMatch radius between a visible item and its BSP spawn record. Applies immediately.
SliderLearning & radiiCluster radiuscl_it_instance_cluster_radiusMerge radius for near-duplicate BSP spawn origins of the same item. Applies immediately.
SliderLearning & radiiOwn pickup radiuscl_it_own_touch_radiusHow close a vanishing item must be to count as YOUR pickup of that exact instance (makes two identical items time separately). Applies immediately.
SliderLearning & radiiManual attach radiuscl_it_pickup_attach_radiusManual it_start <id> <seconds>: how close a BSP spawn must be to attach that manual timer to the nearest instance. Applies immediately.
SectionDiagnosticsDiagnostics
ToggleDiagnosticsWorld debugcl_it_world_debugVerbose world-observation logging to the console (BSP parse, ignored candidates). Applies immediately.
NavigationDiagnosticsPrint world infoit_infoPrint the BSP spawn catalog + observed instances to the console.

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionVideoVideo

ToggleVideoWindowed modevid_windowedvid_windowed: run in a window instead of fullscreen.
ListVideoFullscreen modevid_fullscreen_typeBorderless desktop vs classic exclusive mode. [Desktop fullscreen / Exclusive fullscreen]
Value listVideoResolutionvid_resolutionvid_resolution: desktop = native monitor mode.
Value listVideoRefresh ratevid_refreshvid_refresh: max = highest available; ignored in windowed / desktop modes.
SliderVideoRender scalegl_render_scaleInternal 3D scene resolution (100=native, step 1%).

Primary Settings Masters (q2prox_primary_masters)

Path: Main menu → Primary Settings Masters

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionStartup & Main MenuStartup & Main Menu
ToggleStartup & Main MenuMenu on startupui_openDefault ON. Open the existing Q2PRO-X main menu on an ordinary cold launch. Direct map/server/demo starts are unchanged.
ToggleStartup & Main MenuStartup introcl_q2prox_startup_introDefault ON. Play the separate Q2PRO-X intro only on a cold menu/console launch; any map load stops it.
ToggleStartup & Main MenuAutomatic game statisticscl_game_stats_autoDefault OFF. Refresh your personal game statistics automatically on a plain cold start. Nothing is scanned or parsed in the background while this is off. Applies immediately.
ToggleStartup & Main MenuStatistics in introcl_game_stats_introDefault ON, and inert unless both automatic game statistics and the startup intro are active. During the intro it shows a short sequence of personal moments beside the menu — one fact at a time, appearing and dissolving. With no qualifying match nothing is drawn at all. Applies immediately.
NavigationStartup & Main MenuIntro statistics content...q2prox_game_statistics_introChoose every type of personal fact that may appear in the startup intro. All types are enabled by default.
ToggleStartup & Main MenuPersistent logo lightcl_q2prox_menu_logo_lightDefault OFF. Q2PRO-X / GL sync and filtering (q2prox_gl_sync_filter)

Path: Main menu → Video & Display → Q2PRO-X / GL settings → Q2PRO-X / GL sync and filtering

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionSync & filteringSync & filtering
ListSync & filteringVertical syncgl_swapintervalgl_swapinterval: vertical sync. 0 = off (uncapped), 1 = vsync, -1 = adaptive vsync where supported. Applies immediately. [Off / On / Adaptive]
ListSync & filteringTexture filtergl_texturemodegl_texturemode: texture filtering. GL_NEAREST = nearest neighbour (sharp pixels), GL_LINEAR = bilinear smoothing, GL_NEAREST_MIPMAP_LINEAR = balanced, GL_LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR = trilinear (smoothest). Applies immediately. [Nearest (sharp) / Linear / Nearest+mip / Trilinear]
SliderSync & filteringAnisotropygl_anisotropygl_anisotropy: anisotropic filtering. 1 = off, 2/4/8/16 = increasing quality. Improves angled-surface texture clarity. Applies immediately.
ListSync & filteringMSAAgl_multisamplesgl_multisamples: multi-sample anti-aliasing for the GL context. 0 = off, 2/4/8/16/32 = increasing quality. CVAR_REFRESH — takes effect after vid_restart; driver may downgrade unsupported levels. [Off / 2x / 4x / 8x / 16x / 32x]
ListSync & filteringWGL color buffergl_colorbitsWGL color buffer: Auto matches the target display precision. RGB8 uses 8 bits per RGB channel; RGB10A2 uses 10 bits per RGB channel. Applies after video restart. True HDR uses its separate FP16 path. [Auto / RGB8 / RGB10A2 / Legacy 16 / Legacy 32]
NavigationSync & filteringBackpopmenu

Q2PRO-X / Shader compile and cache (q2prox_gl_shader_cache)

Path: Main menu → Video & Display → Q2PRO-X / GL settings → Q2PRO-X / Shader compile and cache

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionShader compile & cacheShader compile & cache
ListShader compile & cacheShader prewarmgl_shader_prewarmShader prewarm policy. Off = never auto-prewarm. Auto (default) prewarms when AVFX (cl_avfx) OR a renderer feature such as HDR (gl_hdr) is enabled, so unaffected players get no extra loading step. Always keeps the old aggressive stock+AVFX prewarm for diagnostics. [Off / Auto / Always]
ToggleShader compile & cacheAVFX prewarmgl_shader_prewarm_avfxReal include/exclude gate for AVFX-specific shader paths. Used only when the prewarm policy allows running and cl_avfx is on. Default ON. When OFF, prewarm is stock-only and AVFX programs may lazy-compile on first use. Applies immediately.
ToggleShader compile & cachePrewarm verbose loggl_shader_prewarm_verbosePrint per-run prewarm stats to the console (reason / attempted / compiled_new / already_cached / failed / time_ms). Default OFF. Applies immediately.
ToggleShader compile & cacheShader binary cachegl_shader_binary_cacheLoad/save persistent OpenGL program binaries under baseq2/q2pro-x/shcache so warm runs skip GLSL compile. Bad/incompatible binaries fall back to source compile automatically. Default ON. Applies immediately.
ToggleShader compile & cacheWrite shader cachegl_shader_binary_cache_writeWrite newly compiled program binaries to the cache. Turn off to use existing cache read-only without adding new files. Default ON. Applies immediately.
ToggleShader compile & cacheShader prewarm progressgl_shader_prewarm_progressShow a visible progress indicator while shaders compile / load from cache during a cold map load. Default ON. Applies immediately.
ListShader compile & cacheParallel shader compilegl_shader_parallel_compileParallel shader compile during prewarm (GL_ARB/KHR_parallel_shader_compile). Off=serial. Auto (default)=a safe CPU-scaled EGL pool; native WGL Auto stays serial. Aggressive allows the driver maximum or a forced thread count. [Off / Auto / Aggressive]
ListShader compile & cacheShader compile threadsgl_shader_compile_threadsBackground shader-compiler threads. Auto (-1, default)=half the logical CPUs, capped at 8 in normal EGL Auto. Aggressive+Auto requests the driver maximum. None (0)=off; N=fixed count. [Auto / None / 2 / 4 / 8]
ListShader compile & cacheAsync in-flight compilesgl_shader_parallel_inflightAsync shader programs queued during prewarm. Auto (0, default)=twice the safe compiler pool, clamped to 2..16; N=explicit (1..64). Use explicit higher values only with Aggressive mode. [Auto / 8 / 16 / 24 / 32]
ListShader compile & cacheDraw-variant warmupgl_shader_variant_warmupWarm backend draw-time shader variants (ANGLE/D3D) that compile/link prewarm misses, via a tiny scoped sky/water draw + post-draw save. Off/Auto (default)/Aggressive. No effect when cl_avfx is off. [Off / Auto / Aggressive]
NavigationShader compile & cacheClear shader cache...shader_cache_clearDelete cached shader binary FILES under baseq2/q2pro-x/shcache. GL programs already loaded this renderer session stay active. The cache refills from source after a renderer/game restart, or when a program has to be created again.
NavigationShader compile & cacheShader cache info...shader_cache_infoPrint shader binary cache status (supported, hits, misses, loaded_from_binary, compiled_from_source, saved) to the console.
NavigationShader compile & cacheShader prewarm info...shader_prewarm_infoPrint shader prewarm metrics to the console: parallel-compile capability + mode, last prewarm stats (attempted / compiled_new / already_cached / failed), production variant warmup, named resource warmup steps, and lazy-after-prewarm count.
NavigationShader compile & cacheBackpopmenu

SectionArchitecture reliefArchitecture relief

ToggleArchitecture reliefFloors and slopesgl_bsp_tess_architecture_floorsApply generic architecture relief to floors and upward slopes. Applies immediately.

SectionHow this worksHow this works
NavigationHow this worksGlobal settingsecho Standard particle settings are global Q2PRO-X preferences.These are global Q2PRO-X preferences for the standard Quake II particle families. They survive maps, mods, servers and ordinary AVFX or Player Contact preset changes.
NavigationHow this worksParticles offecho Particles off suppresses only future particles of that family.Turning a family off stops only its future particles, before they are allocated or submitted. Particles already in the air finish normally, and the event's count, physics, lifetime, sound and gameplay are unchanged.
NavigationHow this worksOrder of the switchesecho cl_particles and the legacy switches take precedence over the family switches.The broad Particles master and the legacy per-effect switches decide first and always win when they hide something; the family switch is the finest step after them. The colour master above changes the colour of STANDARD families only.
NavigationHow this worksAVFX and Player Contactecho AVFX and Player Contact particles have their own controls.AVFX effects that reuse a stock particle producer are switched and recoloured on their own AVFX pages and in ordinary AVFX presets. Player Contact blood is tuned in Player Contact presets. Nothing here touches either of them.
SectionRelated pagesRelated pages
NavigationRelated pagesParticles & effect visibility...g_particlesThe broad particle master, the legacy per-effect switches, own blood/armor and water warp.
NavigationRelated pagesRail trail setup...g_railtrailRail beam style, duration, core and spiral width, and the core and spiral colour lists.
NavigationRelated pagesReset all standard particlesq2prox_particle_reset allTurn every standard family's Particles back on, turn every Custom colour off and restore every stock reference colour. AVFX, Player Contact, the broad visibility switches, particle shape and rail geometry are not touched.

Skins & Models (g_skins)

Path: Main menu → Options → Skins & Models

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionPlayer ProfilePlayer Profile
NavigationPlayer ProfilePlayer setup (Q2PRO-X)q2prox_player_identityEdit your name, skin, handedness and FOV via Q2PRO-X rows.
NavigationPlayer ProfilePlayer setup (3D preview)playersBuilt-in player setup page with the 3D player model preview.
NavigationPlayer ProfilePlayer highlighting...q2prox_vis_playersOpen player visibility highlight settings: modes, model colours, body-part colours, team and duel logic.
SectionModels & VisibilityModels & Visibility
ListModels & VisibilitySkin restrictioncl_noskinscl_noskins: restrict which player models and skins are loaded. Off keeps every custom skin; male/grunt only forces the stock male model for everyone; + female/athena additionally allows that one stock female skin. Applies immediately. [Off / male/grunt only / male/grunt + female/athena]
ToggleModels & VisibilityVisible weapons on playerscl_vwepcl_vwep: show each player's currently held weapon on their model. Applies immediately.
ToggleModels & VisibilityMD5 loadgl_md5_loadLoad re-release MD5 replacement models. CVAR_FILES — requires vid_restart or map reload.
ToggleModels & VisibilityMD5 usegl_md5_useUse loaded MD5 models. Only effective if gl_md5_load is enabled. Applies immediately.
SliderModels & VisibilityMD5 distancegl_md5_distanceOnly use MD5 replacement model if entity is closer than this distance to the viewer. 0 = no distance LOD. Applies immediately.
SectionLocal OverrideLocal Override
ToggleLocal OverrideMod skin overridecl_mod_skin_overrideLocal-only player skin substitution. When on, the local renderer and local sexed-sound resolver can use a chosen model/skin for the local player and/or everyone else. Server userinfo and other clients are unaffected. Saved per mod (OpenFFA/OpenTDM/baseq2 keep separate values). Applies immediately.
ListLocal OverrideSelf skincl_mod_skin_override_selfModel/skin shown and heard locally for the LOCAL player. Empty = keep real server skin and sounds. Applies immediately. [Real server skin / female / athena / female / voodoo / female / jezebel / male / grunt / male / cipher / male / deaddude / cyborg / oni911]
ListLocal OverrideOthers skincl_mod_skin_override_othersModel/skin shown and heard locally for ALL OTHER players. Empty = keep real server skins and sounds. Applies immediately. [Real server skin / female / athena / female / voodoo / female / jezebel / male / grunt / male / cipher / male / deaddude / cyborg / oni911]
NavigationLocal OverridePreset: me female, others maleset cl_mod_skin_override 1; set cl_mod_skin_override_self female/athena; set cl_mod_skin_override_others male/gruntPreset: enable override, set self=female/athena, others=male/grunt (OpenFFA DM look)
NavigationLocal OverrideClear override valuesreset cl_mod_skin_override_self; reset cl_mod_skin_override_othersClear self/others override values (keeps master toggle)
NavigationLocal OverrideOverride status...mso_statusPrint current mod skin override state and resolved assets to the console.
SectionFiles & ModsFiles & Mods
NavigationFiles & ModsDownload options...g_downloadsAuto-download options for maps, models, skins, textures, sounds and HTTP.
NavigationFiles & ModsMod command overlay...q2prox_modhelpMod command overlay for mod-specific skin commands (teamskin, eskin, etc.).

Downloads (g_downloads)

Path: Main menu → Online Play Setup → Downloads

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
ToggleAllow downloadingallow_downloadMaster switch for downloading missing files from servers. Applies immediately.
ToggleMapsallow_download_mapsDownload missing map (.bsp) files. Applies immediately.
TogglePlayer models / skinsallow_download_playersDownload missing player models and skins. Applies immediately.
ToggleModelsallow_download_modelsDownload missing model files. Applies immediately.
ToggleTexturesallow_download_texturesDownload missing world textures. Applies immediately.
ToggleSoundsallow_download_soundsDownload missing sound files. Applies immediately.
TogglePicsallow_download_picsDownload missing image / HUD files. Applies immediately.

Q2PRO-X / Single Player Experiments (q2prox_sp_experiments)

Path: In-game menu → Q2PRO-X / Single Player Experiments

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionModesModes
NavigationModesItem and Monster Randomizerq2prox_sp_mutatorRandomize item and monster classes when a map is loaded. Seed 0 gives a fresh layout every load; non-zero seed repeats the same layout.
NavigationModesDM Map Trainingq2prox_sp_dm_trainingPlay DM maps in local single player with monsters spawned at multiplayer start points, optional respawn and optional scoring.
NavigationModesGeometry Deformationq2prox_sp_geo_deformVisually changes the level mesh for local single player: uneven surfaces, stronger geometry variation, and optional rounded corners. Movement and collision stay original.
NavigationModesMonster Appearance Variantsq2prox_sp_monster_variantsMake repeated monsters look like different individuals: subtle size and color variation, with feet kept planted on the floor. Local single player only; no gameplay or hitbox changes.
NavigationModesLiquid Swapq2prox_sp_liquid_swapReplace water with lava (or lava with water) in local single player: real damage, physics, material and AVFX. Off by default; no effect in deathmatch/coop/demo.
SectionMonstersMonsters
ToggleMonstersFree Worldcl_sp_free_worldIdle monsters walk around the level instead of standing still until they see you. They walk, never run, and go where they are facing. Ambush monsters and patrols wander too - that is the point. Off by default. Local single player only. Applies immediately.
ToggleMonstersSkill-based monster speedcl_sp_monster_skill_speedApplies DM-training-like skill speed (1x/1.5x/3x/5x at skill 0/1/2/3) to ordinary local single-player campaign monsters. Off by default. Does not affect deathmatch, coop, demo, or DM-training maps. Applies immediately.
SliderMonstersSkill speed intensitycl_sp_monster_skill_speed_scaleStrength of the skill speed multiplier above 1.0x. Default 1.0 = exact P1d table; 0.5 = half the additional speed. 2.0 = Double the additional speed. Applies immediately.
SectionLightningLightning
ToggleLightningLightning damages monsterscl_sp_avfx_lightning_damageLightning radial-damages nearby monsters in local single-player and DM-training. Off by default. No effect in deathmatch / coop / demos / remote multiplayer. Player and items not damaged. Bosses included by default. (Mirrored from AVFX / Storm & Sky for convenience.) Applies immediately.
SliderLightningLightning damage amountcl_sp_avfx_lightning_damage_amountDamage at strike center (rocket-class default 120). Falls off to ~25% at the radius edge. Tougher monsters survive more strikes. Applies immediately.
SliderLightningLightning damage radiuscl_sp_avfx_lightning_damage_radiusDamage radius in world units (default 800, ~5x grenade launcher splash). Damage falls off with distance from strike center. Applies immediately.
ToggleLightningRequire line of sightcl_sp_avfx_lightning_damage_losRequire line-of-sight from strike point to monster center: lightning does not hurt monsters behind thick walls (MASK_SOLID trace). Applies immediately.
ToggleLightningLightning breaks objectscl_sp_avfx_lightning_damage_breakablesAllow AVFX lightning to damage nearby explosive barrels (misc_explobox) and breakable func_explosive brushes using the same amount/radius/falloff settings as monster lightning damage. Off by default. Doors, buttons, triggers and scripted entities are never affected. Applies immediately.
SectionContacts & DiagnosticsContacts & Diagnostics
NavigationContacts & DiagnosticsMonster AVFX contacts...q2prox_avfx_monster_contactsMonster AVFX contacts: footprints on snow, puddle ripples, landing splashes (local SP / DM-training).
NavigationContacts & DiagnosticsMutator info...svPrint active mutation mode, seed, map name, and per-load mutation counters.

Q2PRO-X / Single Player — Geometry (q2prox_sp_geo_deform)

Path: In-game menu → Q2PRO-X / Single Player Experiments → Q2PRO-X / Single Player — Geometry

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionBasicsBasics
ToggleBasicsDeform geometrycl_sp_geo_deformTurns visual level deformation on or off for local single player. Movement, collision, saves and server logic stay unchanged. Applies immediately.
SliderBasicsDeformation strengthcl_sp_geo_deform_presetOverall geometry variation. 0 turns the feature off. Higher values make the level shape more visibly uneven, up to the safe maximum at 100. Applies immediately.
SliderBasicsVariation seedcl_sp_geo_deform_seedRepeatable variation seed. Same map, seed and settings give the same visual shape; changing it rerolls the level look. Applies immediately.
ToggleBasicsAVFX follows surfacecl_sp_geo_deform_avfx_syncLets AVFX visual overlays such as puddles, snow and rings follow the changed visible surface where possible. Applies immediately.
SectionRounded cornersRounded corners
ToggleRounded cornersRound cornerscl_sp_geo_round_edgesAdds visual rounded corners to suitable static wall edges. Moving platforms, liquids, sky and transparent surfaces are left untouched. Applies immediately.
SliderRounded cornersCorner roundnesscl_sp_geo_round_edges_amountHow strongly corners are rounded. 0 hides the rounded surfaces; 100 uses the full selected radius. Applies immediately.
SliderRounded cornersCorner radiuscl_sp_geo_round_edges_radiusApproximate width of rounded corners in world units. Short edges are limited automatically. Applies immediately.
SliderRounded cornersCorner smoothnesscl_sp_geo_round_edges_segmentsSmoothness of rounded corners. Higher values look smoother but add more geometry. Applies immediately.
SliderRounded cornersCorner angle thresholdcl_sp_geo_round_edges_angle_thresholdWhich angles are sharp enough to receive rounding. Higher values affect fewer, sharper corners. Applies immediately.
SectionManual displacementManual displacement
SliderManual displacementLarge displacementcl_sp_geo_deform_strengthManual broad displacement amount. Usually controlled by the main strength row above. Applies immediately.
SliderManual displacementSurface tiltcl_sp_geo_deform_tiltManual surface tilt amount. Higher values make surfaces lean more. Applies immediately.
SliderManual displacementFine roughnesscl_sp_geo_deform_noiseManual fine roughness. Lower it if very small visual noise is unwanted. Applies immediately.

NavigationServiceGeometry info...sp_geo_deform_infoPrint current geometry settings and rebuild counters to the console.

Config & Files (g_config)

Path: Main menu → Options → Config & Files

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionBasicsBasics
ToggleBasicsStartup introcl_q2prox_startup_introDefault ON. Plays the separate Q2PRO-X intro once on a cold menu/console launch. Game-music settings do not affect it. Direct map/server/demo starts suppress it; loading a map stops it. OFF stops it now; ON applies next launch.
ToggleBasicsAutomatic game statisticscl_game_stats_autoDefault OFF. Refresh your personal game statistics automatically on a plain cold start. Nothing is scanned or parsed in the background while this is off. Applies immediately.
ToggleBasicsStatistics in introcl_game_stats_introDefault ON, and inert unless both automatic game statistics and the startup intro are active. During the intro it shows a short sequence of personal moments beside the menu — one fact at a time, appearing and dissolving. With no qualifying match nothing is drawn at all. Applies immediately.
ToggleBasicsAutosave configcl_q2prox_cfg_autosaveAuto-save the Q2PRO-X config (global + mod-local) whenever you change a setting in the menu. Applies immediately.
ToggleBasicsMod scanningcl_q2prox_modscanScan first-level mod folders at startup for game DLLs (feeds the Mods menu). Off = Mods menu shows only baseq2 (local). Applies immediately.
ToggleBasicsDisable AVFX globallycl_avfx_global_disableGlobal override for all mods. When enabled, AVFX is effectively off everywhere without changing each mod's local AVFX preset. Turn it off later to restore the per-mod AVFX settings. Applies immediately.
NavigationBasicsMod configs...q2prox_modcfgPer-mod config profiles for BaseQ2, OpenTDM and OpenFFA: four named presets each, one of them the default that is applied automatically when you enter that mod. A preset is applied on top of your settings and is never written into a saved config.
NavigationBasicsImport missing legacy settings...q2prox_global_prefsAdds Q2PRO-X global settings that are still missing from the global config. Existing values and every key binding are left exactly as they are; nothing is replaced and no per-mod config is touched.
ToggleBasicsAlt+F4 quitcl_altf4_exitLet Alt+F4 immediately quit the game. Applies immediately.
SectionLanguage & Other FontsLanguage & Other Fonts
ListLanguage & Other FontsRussian display localizationcl_console_utf8_ruRussian display-localization baseline. Auto = on for Russian Windows, Off = English/legacy, On = forced Russian. Display only; does not enable Russian console input. [Auto / Off / On]
ListLanguage & Other FontsConsole fontcl_console_font_modeConsole font. Legacy = stock conchars, San Francisco = SFUIText Regular fixed-cell. Console only. Applies immediately. [Legacy / San Francisco]
ListLanguage & Other FontsBrowsers fontcl_browser_font_modeBrowser/UI chrome typography. legacy = stock conchars, Iskra = Iskra Cyrillic Regular fixed-cell. Wired: server / cvar / demo browser, demo player overlay chrome, modhelp local UI. Raw server names / demo filenames stay on the byte-exact legacy path. Applies immediately. [Legacy / Iskra]
ListLanguage & Other FontsHUD fontcl_hud_font_modeHUD/local-overlay typography. legacy = stock conchars, Iskra = Iskra Cyrillic Regular fixed-cell. Wired trusted: net autoport, demo item timers, demo analytics, screen.c local labels (demo bar, LAGHAX), OpenTDM team HUD trusted chrome. Server-supplied layout / configstring / chat / scoreboard names stay on the byte-exact legacy path. Applies immediately. [Legacy / Iskra]
SectionBinds & SaveBinds & Save
KeyBinds & SaveCvar browser toggle keycvar_browser_toggleKey that shows/hides the Q2PRO-X cvar reference overlay.
ListBinds & SaveBare writeconfig savescl_writeconfig_fullWhat a bare writeconfig <file> (typed with no -a/-b/-c/-m) saves. Explicit flags always win and are never broadened by this. This is a manual CFG export, not Q2PRO-X preset saving. Applies immediately. [Bindings + archived / Everything (-b -m -a)]
NavigationBinds & SaveSave all configs...q2prox_cfg_saveSave all Q2PRO-X settings (both global and mod-local configs).
NavigationBinds & SaveSave global config...q2prox_cfg_save_globalSave global settings to baseq2/q2pro-x/q2pro-x.cfg.
NavigationBinds & SaveSave local config...q2prox_cfg_save_localDuring normal play saves the mod-local config. During .dm2/.mvd2 playback saves the demo-visual preset. Target filename is printed to console.
NavigationBinds & SaveSave demo visual config...q2prox_cfg_save_demo_visualAlways writes baseq2/q2pro-x/demo_visual/q2pro-x.demo.cfg. The visual preset used only during demo playback.
SectionResetReset
NavigationResetDefaults all...q2prox_cfg_defaultsReset every Q2PRO-X setting back to its default.
NavigationResetDefaults global...q2prox_cfg_defaults_globalReset only the global settings to defaults.
NavigationResetDefaults local...q2prox_cfg_defaults_localReset local cvars. During demo playback: only visual cvars (binds kept) into the demo-visual target. Otherwise: mod-local cvars + binds.
NavigationResetDefaults demo visual...q2prox_cfg_defaults_demo_visualReset only the demo-visual cvars to defaults (binds always kept). Run q2prox_cfg_save_demo_visual afterwards to persist.

Performance & Budget HUD (q2prox_perf_hud)

Path: Main menu → Help / About Q2PRO-X → Performance & Budget HUD

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionGeneralGeneral
ToggleGeneralPerformance HUDcl_perf_hudDefault OFF. Show the live performance and budget HUD. While it is off the HUD performs no timing, no GPU query, no counting and no drawing. Applies immediately.
SliderGeneralUpdate intervalcl_perf_hud_intervalHow often a new snapshot is published, in seconds. Between publications the cached snapshot is drawn and its age is shown in the title. Applies immediately.
SliderGeneralOpacitycl_perf_hud_alphaOpacity of the HUD background and text, independent of scr_alpha. Applies immediately.
SliderGeneralText scalecl_perf_hud_scaleText-size multiplier for this HUD only, independent of scr_scale. Applies immediately.
ToggleGeneralPillarbox free areacl_perf_hud_pillarbox_workspaceAllow placing the HUD in the pillarbox side bars. Applies immediately.
ToggleGeneralOnly active metricscl_perf_hud_active_onlyDefault ON. Show only metrics that are doing something now: an off, blocked or empty family is hidden, so puddle and snow rows go away when it is neither raining nor snowing. Hidden metrics are still measured and reappear at once. Applies immediately.
ToggleGeneralOnly in gamecl_perf_hud_ingame_onlyDefault ON. Draw the HUD only on a loaded, playing map - not in the main menu, not on a loading screen, not while disconnected. While hidden it collects nothing. Applies immediately.
ToggleGeneralShow in menucl_perf_hud_show_in_menuDefault ON. Keep the HUD visible while a menu is open. Turn it off and the HUD steps aside for the menu even on a loaded map, and returns when the menu closes. Applies immediately.
SectionColumnsColumns
ToggleColumnsCost columncl_perf_hud_show_costDefault ON. Show the whole cost column - everything to the right of the bars. Turn it off for a compact list of names and values only. Applies immediately.

Ping Adaptation (q2prox_ping_adaptation)

Path: Main menu → Online Play Setup → Ping Adaptation

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionModeMode
ListModeAdaptation modecl_ping_adapt_modeHold an absolute target ping. Off adds nothing. Manual holds your own target; Automatic takes it from the source below. The value is the FINAL ping, not an addition: real 10 with a target of 30 adds about 20, and a real ping already above the target adds nothing. Applies immediately. [Off / Manual / Automatic]
ListModeAutomatic sourcecl_ping_adapt_auto_sourceWhere Automatic takes its target: a configured range, or the active opposing players (OpenTDM: the other team; OpenFFA: the other active players). Spectators and you are always excluded. Applies immediately. [Range / Players]
SectionManualManual
SliderManualTarget pingcl_ping_adapt_manual_msAbsolute target ping for Manual mode. A target below your real ping simply adds nothing. Applies immediately.
SectionAutomatic rangeAutomatic range
SliderAutomatic rangeMinimumcl_ping_adapt_range_min_msLower bound of the band. Adaptation runs only while your real ping is below this value; one target is then chosen inside the band and held stable. Applies immediately.
SliderAutomatic rangeMaximumcl_ping_adapt_range_max_msUpper bound of the band. Both bounds are additionally limited by the maximum final ping below. Applies immediately.
SectionPlayersPlayers
SliderPlayersCheck intervalcl_ping_adapt_check_interval_msHow often the target and the opposing roster are recomputed. Server requests are combined and never sent more than once per second. Applies immediately.
SliderPlayersOffsetcl_ping_adapt_offset_msSigned offset from the opponents' ping. Target = opponent ping + offset. Example: opponent 40 with offset -10 gives a target of 30. Applies immediately.
SliderPlayersMinimum differencecl_ping_adapt_min_difference_msAdaptation starts only when your real ping is below the opponents' ping by at least this much. Example: opponent 40 and 15 here leaves a real ping of 30 alone. Applies immediately.
SliderPlayersMaximum final pingcl_ping_adapt_max_msHard ceiling for the final target in Automatic mode. Applies to both automatic sources and never to Manual. Applies immediately.
SectionServiceService
ToggleServiceEvent logcl_ping_adapt_debugLog adaptation events to the console: mode changes, target changes, roster updates. Never prints per packet. Applies immediately.
NavigationServicePrint informationping_adapt_infoPrint the full current state: real and adapted ping, target, added delay, opposing players and queue.
NavigationServiceReset controllerping_adapt_resetRestart measurement and roster tracking without changing any setting. Packets already waiting are sent in order first.

SectionAutomatic policyAutomatic policy

NavigationProtection & testingNetwork Lab...q2prox_network_god_labGenerate synthetic delay, loss and reordering to see how the game behaves. Clearly marked and stopped by one action.

SectionContinuous monitoringContinuous monitoring
ToggleContinuous monitoringContinuous checkcl_network_god_traffic_monitorContinuously measure background receive and transmit traffic during a live Network God session. Default off: no repeated adapter sampling. Warnings require sustained load and clear slowly, so normal bursts do not flash. Applies immediately.
ToggleContinuous monitoringApplication analysiscl_network_god_traffic_app_scanOptionally look for a possible application source after sustained traffic is confirmed. Works only with Continuous check. Default off: no process, service or endpoint scan. A found application is a hint, never exact byte attribution. Applies immediately.
SliderContinuous monitoringReceive threshold (KiB/s)cl_network_god_traffic_rx_kbpsSustained background receive rate in KiB/s. It covers routed physical Internet carriers, including a VPN underlay, after the client's own datagrams are subtracted. It is not ISP capacity. Applies immediately.
SliderContinuous monitoringTransmit threshold (KiB/s)cl_network_god_traffic_tx_kbpsSustained background transmit rate in KiB/s. Upload pressure is separated because it often harms gameplay before a large download does. Applies immediately.
SliderContinuous monitoringSustain time (s)cl_network_god_traffic_sustain_secHow many continuous seconds the threshold must be exceeded before the overlay warns. Short Steam, browser and Windows bursts are ignored. Applies immediately.
SectionHow to read itHow to read it

ListGeneration setupCelestial bodiescl_avfxgen_celestialCelestial bodies only: Sun, planets/Earth and Black Hole. Random chooses any tier-allowed subset; a fixed body is exact. Black Hole needs Ultra and supplies its required star backdrop. Inert until Generate. Applies immediately. [Random / Off / Sun / Planets/Earth / Black Hole / All compatible]
ListGeneration setupMeteors and shipscl_avfxgen_trafficIndependent moving-sky selector. Random (default) chooses any tier-allowed subset; Off disables all; All compatible enables every allowed kind. A fixed kind is exact. Inert until Generate. Applies immediately. [Random / Off / All compatible / Impact meteors / Sky meteors / Comets / Spaceships]
ListGeneration setupAtmospheric effectscl_avfxgen_atmosphereAtmospheric effect families. Lightning requires Rain: a Random main resolves to Rain+Storm, a fixed incompatible one is refused. Clouds = flat + volumetric by tier. Inert until Generate. Applies immediately. [Random / Off / Lightning / Volumetric fog / Clouds / Fog and clouds / All compatible]
ListGeneration setupSurfacescl_avfxgen_surfacesPreliminary material, covering and wildlife choice. Surface Objects have their own independent selector below. Applies immediately. [Random / Off / Materials / Coverings / Wildlife / All compatible]
ListGeneration setupWater and puddlescl_avfxgen_waterWater and puddle families. Fixed Puddles require the Rain atmosphere: a Random main resolves to Rain, a fixed incompatible one is refused. Changes nothing until Generate is pressed. Applies immediately. [Random / Off / Water / Puddles / Water and puddles]
ListGeneration setupSurface materialscl_avfxgen_materialsFinal material policy. Random keeps the preliminary Surfaces result. Always enables at least two eligible Surface Material layers at full opacity. Off disables all seven eligible layers. Wildlife, Drawings and 3D grass stay separate. Applies immediately. [Random / Always / Off]
ListGeneration setupSurface objectscl_avfxgen_objectsIndependent 3D object choice. Random selects a bounded set; All selects every compatible category. Available from Balanced; shadows vary only from Quality. Ultra/Extra disable LOD. Applies immediately. [Random / Off / All compatible / Grass / Wall foliage / Ferns / Stones and rubble / Soil clumps / Fallen leaves]
ListGeneration setupWildlifecl_avfxgen_wildlifeFinal wildlife policy. Random keeps the preliminary Surfaces result. Always enables fully opaque wildlife with random mixing of all species; Off disables it. Coverage never changes wildlife. Applies immediately. [Random / Always / Off]
ListGeneration setupSurface coverage zonecl_avfxgen_coverageSurface coverage zone. Full maximises the coverage of mold, greenery, brick, cracks and the floor and wall coverings and lays them out uniformly, so a level reads as finished rather than patchy. Random leaves those amounts to the generator. Wildlife and wall-water runoff are never touched. Applies immediately. [Random / Full]

ToggleCore SettingsEnablecl_avfxMaster switch for the AVFX atmospheric layer (rain/snow/ash/dust/mist, storm). Visual-only, client-side. Applies immediately.

SliderCore SettingsAir alphacl_avfx_air_alpha_scaleAlpha multiplier for the additional air layer only. Applies immediately.
ListCore SettingsQualitycl_avfx_qualityPer-frame budget: low/normal/high sets the cap on rain beams and particles. Applies immediately. [low / normal / high]
ListCore SettingsAVFX backendcl_avfx_backendAVFX surface/state backend. Classic keeps the legacy behaviour. Accelerated enables the modern dirty-tile/reservoir paths used by accelerated weather rendering. Applies immediately. [Classic / Accelerated]
ListCore SettingsWeather renderercl_avfx_weather_rendererWeather render path. Classic uses the legacy CPU/entity path. Accelerated/Auto can use the modern path when the AVFX backend is Accelerated. Applies immediately. [Classic / Accelerated / Auto]
ToggleCore SettingsDistance LODcl_avfx_render_lodSkip rendering small AVFX effects (foam bubbles, water ripples, puddle rings, splashes, puddle dust) beyond cl_avfx_render_lod_wu distance from camera, with soft fade over the last 30%. Major perf win in dense rain (~15-25%+ fps). Puddles, cascade flows, and rain particles themselves are NEVER affected. Applies immediately.
SliderCore SettingsLOD distancecl_avfx_render_lod_wuDistance LOD threshold in world units. Effects beyond this fade out and are skipped. Default 1536. Applies immediately.
ListCore SettingsWeather strengthcl_avfx_weather_levelWeather strength bias (light/normal/heavy) for density, fall speed, wind and storm chance. Your sliders still apply. Applies immediately. [light / normal / heavy]

SliderShape & WindHeightcl_avfx_heightVertical height (world units) of the weather column around the camera. Applies immediately.

SliderShape & WindWind Ycl_avfx_wind_yWind along Y: slants streaks and drifts particles north (+) / south (-). Applies immediately.

SectionMasterMaster
ToggleMasterSurface Volumescl_avfx_surface_volumesShow volumetric steam and smoke in the areas you marked on this map. It appears in the current map immediately: no map reload and no video restart. Needs cl_avfx on. Default off. Applies immediately.
ListMasterQualitycl_avfx_surface_volumes_qualityVolume detail for every shape independently. One shader serves every tier, so changing this compiles nothing. Applies immediately. [Low / Balanced / High / Ultra]
SliderMasterShape densitycl_avfx_surface_volumes_gpu_budget_msCalibrated density control for each visible shape. Adding a shape leaves existing shapes unchanged; total GPU load grows with visible shape count. Applies immediately.
SliderMasterPer-shape primitive limitcl_avfx_surface_volumes_max_lobesUpper bound on volume primitives built for EACH shape. It is never divided between shapes. Applies immediately.

An area always draws WHOLE and fades out completely at its cutoff — never in pieces. Applies immediately. [Off / Near / Medium / Far]
SectionEditorEditor
NavigationEditorOpen editoravfx_surface_volumes_editorOpen the editor. It opens in Paint mode: the mouse moves a cursor and the camera stays frozen. Tab switches to Navigate to move the view; Escape closes. EVERY per-area parameter — colour, shape, motion, turbulence, light response — is edited inside the editor panel with sliders, on its group tabs.
SectionPresetPreset
NavigationPresetSaveavfx_surface_volumes_saveSave this map's steam and smoke now. The layout is kept per mod and per map and comes back the next time you enter this map; it also saves automatically when you leave the map or the game. SliderWall distributionWall fadecl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_wall_fadeSmooth transition width of the top-fed reach limit. Never a hard cut. Applies immediately.
SectionFamiliesFamilies
NavigationFamiliesMotion...q2prox_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_motionOpen Motion settings: flow speed, trail length and droplet/stream balance.

NavigationServiceReset wall runoffcl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_wall_waterReset wall runoff controls to defaults.

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionMotionMotion
SliderMotionSpeedcl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_speedFlow speed of descending beads. Live change alters velocity smoothly without teleporting beads. Applies immediately.
SliderMotionTrail lengthcl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_trail_lengthLength of the damp trail behind each bead. Smaller = short faint tails; larger = long tracks. Applies immediately.
SliderMotionDroplet/stream balancecl_avfx_surface_materials_wall_water_droplet_balanceBalance discrete droplets (0) vs continuous streams (1); in between mixes both. Applies immediately.

Brick surfaces (q2prox_avfx_surface_materials_brick)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Surfaces & Water → Surface Materials → Brick surfaces

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionMasterMaster
ToggleMasterBrick surfacescl_avfx_surface_materials_brickBrick family master. Irregular masonry with real bump and parallax relief on eligible static walls and floors. Needs the Surface Materials master. The original texture stays underneath according to coverage; map geometry, collision and gameplay are untouched. Default off. Applies immediately.
ToggleMasterWallscl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wallsCoat eligible walls. Independent of the floor lane. Applies immediately.
ToggleMasterFloorscl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_floorsCoat eligible floors and gentle slopes. Independent of the wall lane. Applies immediately.
ListMasterMasonry appearancecl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_variantMasonry appearance. Auto lets world regions choose, blending at most two neighbours into one grid. Applies immediately. [Auto / Clean masonry / Aged uneven / Exposed under plaster / Dark industrial / Pale masonry / Damp chipped relief]
SectionAppearanceAppearance
SliderAppearanceAlphacl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_alphaOverall blend into the original surface. 0 is a real no-op. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceCoveragecl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_coverageHow much of the surface is coated. Below one it exposes broad irregular islands of the original texture; it never deletes single bricks. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceCoverage softnesscl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_coverage_softnessSoftness of the coated-area boundary only. It does not change brick or joint width. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceBrick scalecl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_scalePhysical brick and course size. It does not change which region picks which profile. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceReliefcl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_reliefVisual bump and parallax relief: faces stand proud of the joints as the view angle changes. Visual only — geometry and collision never change. 0 is the cheap flat path. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceBrick geometrycl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_geometryReal geometric relief: bricks physically stand out of the wall on tessellated surfaces, so the edge of a wall is no longer a straight line. It brings its own tessellation, so nothing else has to be enabled. 0 is off and costs nothing. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceMortar widthcl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_mortar_widthWidth of the mortar joint. Independent of joint depth. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceMortar depthcl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_mortar_depthHow deeply the joint is recessed below the brick faces. Independent of joint width. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceIrregularitycl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_irregularityBounded variation of course drift, brick length and joint edges. Stable in the world, never animated. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceChippingcl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_chippingBroken corners and face fragments. They change height and material response, not just tint. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceColour variationcl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_color_variationRestrained per-brick material variation. Stable per brick; it never becomes a multicolour pattern. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceRed tintcl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_tint_rRed multiplier over the brick palette. 1 is neutral. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceGreen tintcl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_tint_gGreen multiplier over the brick palette. 1 is neutral. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceBlue tintcl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_tint_bBlue multiplier over the brick palette. 1 is neutral. Applies immediately.
SectionWall distributionWall distribution
ListWall distributionDistributioncl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wall_distributionSpread on walls. The bottom-up band coats the wall from its base. Floors are unaffected. Applies immediately. [Uniform / Bottom-up band]
SliderWall distributionWall heightcl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wall_heightHow far the coated band reaches up the wall. Ignored in uniform mode and on floors. Applies immediately.
SliderWall distributionWall fadecl_avfx_surface_materials_brick_wall_fadeSmooth width of the band boundary. Always broken by world noise, never a straight line. Applies immediately.
SectionServiceService
NavigationServiceReset brick surfacescl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_brickReset brick surface controls to defaults.
NavigationServiceBack to Surface Materials...q2prox_avfx_surface_materialsBack to Surface Materials.

Drawing (q2prox_avfx_surface_materials_drawing)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Surfaces & Water → Surface Materials → Drawing

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionMasterMaster
ToggleMasterDrawingcl_avfx_surface_materials_drawingShow your own drawings on world surfaces. Drawings are local, saved separately for each mod and each map revision, and are never deleted by a reset or a preset. Default off. Applies immediately.
ToggleMasterWalls and ceilingscl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_wallsShow and allow drawing on eligible walls and ceilings. Turning it off hides those drawings; it never deletes them. Applies immediately.
ToggleMasterFloors and slopescl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_floorsShow and allow drawing on eligible floors and up-slopes. Turning it off hides those drawings; it never deletes them. Applies immediately.
SectionEditorEditor
NavigationEditorOpen editoravfx_surface_drawing_editorOpen the drawing editor. It opens in Paint mode: the mouse moves a cursor and the camera stays frozen. Tab switches to Navigate to move the view; Escape closes.
NavigationEditorDocument infoavfx_surface_drawing_infoPrint the current mod, map, BSP revision, file path, layer/stroke counts and save state to the console.
NavigationEditorSaveavfx_surface_drawing_saveSave the current drawing now. Editing also autosaves shortly after each completed stroke.
SectionEditor panelEditor panel
SliderEditor panelPanel opacitycl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_editor_alphaOpacity of the editor toolbox. Affects the panel only, never the drawings. Applies immediately.
SliderEditor panelPanel scalecl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_editor_scaleSize multiplier for the editor toolbox. Applies immediately.
SliderEditor panelPanel widthcl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_editor_widthBase width of the editor toolbox in pixels, before the scale multiplier. Applies immediately.
SliderEditor panelPanel heightcl_avfx_surface_materials_drawing_editor_heightBase height of the editor toolbox in pixels, before the scale multiplier. Applies immediately.
NavigationEditor panelReset panel positionavfx_surface_drawing_panel_resetPut the toolbox back to its default place. You can also drag it by its title bar.
SectionServiceService
NavigationServiceReset settingscl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_drawingReset the display and editor settings to defaults. Saved drawings are not touched.

Floor Surfaces (q2prox_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Surfaces & Water → Surface Materials → Floor Surfaces

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
ToggleEnablecl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfacesMaster for this Surface Coverings layer. It needs the Surface Materials master and at least one receiver lane. The layer name only selects its catalog and its default lane; it never restricts geometry. Default off. Applies immediately.
NavigationMaterial...q2prox_avfx_coverings_pick_floorCatalog 1..160; metal 129..160. Local room reflection, directional sheen and filtered highlights, not a precise mirror. Detail follows Materials Quality; rotation and roughness shape the sheen.
ToggleFloorscl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_floorsAllow this layer on eligible floors and gentle up-slopes. Applies immediately.
ToggleWallscl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_wallsAllow this layer on eligible walls and steep faces. Applies immediately.
ToggleCeilingscl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_ceilingsAllow this layer on eligible ceilings and undersides. Ceilings are a lane of their own: switching it on does not change any other material family. Applies immediately.
SliderAlphacl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_alphaHow strongly an accepted covering blends over the original BSP material. 0 is a real no-op: the layer stops before any hash, noise, texture, relief or motion work. Applies immediately.
SliderCoveragecl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_coverageArea of the coverage field — WHERE the covering exists, which is independent of alpha. 0 is a real no-op. Applies immediately.
SliderEdge softnesscl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_coverage_softnessFeather of the covered/uncovered boundary only. It never changes the material's own grain or motif. Applies immediately.
SliderScalecl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_scaleUser multiplier on the recipe's own physical scale. 1 keeps the size the reference photograph implies. Applies immediately.
SliderRotationcl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_rotationRotation of the material within the surface plane. It is anchored to the BSP plane, so it does not turn with the camera. Applies immediately.
SliderStretchcl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_stretchAnisotropic stretch of the material along the surface. 1 is square. Applies immediately.
SliderRedcl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_tint_rRed multiplier of the material colour. 1 is neutral: the recipe's own palette is used unchanged. Applies immediately.
SliderGreencl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_tint_gGreen multiplier of the material colour. 1 is neutral. Applies immediately.
SliderBluecl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_tint_bBlue multiplier of the material colour. 1 is neutral. Applies immediately.
ListDistributioncl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_distributionHow the coverage field is laid out over the world. The mode changes what reach, softness and direction mean, but not their stored value. Applies immediately. [Uniform / Natural islands / Clustered / Bottom-up / Top-down / Directional bands / Slope-biased]
SliderField sizecl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_distribution_scaleSize of the macro field the distribution mode works with. Small = many small areas; large = a few broad ones. Applies immediately.
SliderReachcl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_distribution_reachZone or bias of the distribution mode: the band reach for bottom-up and top-down, and the slope bias for the slope mode. Applies immediately.
SliderMode softnesscl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_distribution_softnessFeather of the distribution mode's own boundary. Independent of the coverage-edge softness. Applies immediately.
SliderDirectioncl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_distribution_directionDirection the banded and gradient distribution modes follow. Ignored by the modes that have no direction. Applies immediately.
SliderReliefcl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_reliefStrength of the bump and normal response. It changes how the surface catches light; BSP vertices, collision, silhouette and depth are never touched. Applies immediately.
SliderDepthcl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_depthBounded parallax depth. The offset is clamped and fades out at grazing angles and at distance, so it never smears or samples past a face edge. Applies immediately.
SliderCavity shadingcl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_cavityDarkening inside the material's own hollows. Contact shading of the relief, never invented emission. Applies immediately.
SliderRoughnesscl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_roughnessPrivate material response of this layer: low values read as damp or polished, high values as dry and matte. Applies immediately.
SliderMetal reflectioncl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_metal_reflectionRoom reflection strength for metal in this layer: 0 disables the captured reflection, 1 is normal, 2 boosts it. Does not change transparency or mirror/water quality. Applies immediately.
SliderDirectional metal sheencl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_metal_anisotropyDirectional metal sheen strength: 0 is isotropic, 1 uses the material recipe, 2 strengthens the direction. Layer rotation controls its orientation. Applies immediately.
SliderMetal highlight smoothingcl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_metal_antialiasReduces tiny unstable highlights from fine metal normals: 0 disables smoothing, 1 is normal, 2 is softer. Does not change the chosen roughness value. Applies immediately.
ListMotioncl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_modeShader-only motion of this layer, off by default. It is world-anchored, so it does not swim with the camera and a mirror shows the same phase as the direct view. The two layers move independently. Applies immediately. [Off / Drift / Ripple / Swirl / Pulse]
SliderAmplitudecl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_strengthMotion amplitude. Exactly 0 is a real no-motion path, not a slow animation. Applies immediately.
SliderSpeedcl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_speedSpeed of this layer's motion. The module owns one clock; this multiplies it, which is what makes the two layers independent. Applies immediately.
SliderField frequencycl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_scaleSpatial frequency of the motion field: small = long slow waves, large = fine busy movement. Applies immediately.
SliderDirectioncl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_directionDirection of drift and ripple motion. Swirl and pulse use it as a bias. Applies immediately.
SliderTurbulencecl_avfx_surface_materials_floor_surfaces_motion_turbulenceHow non-linear the motion field is. 0 is a clean regular movement; 1 is broken and irregular. Applies immediately.
ListWhat lies underneathcl_avfx_surface_materials_coverings_orderWhich of the two Surface Coverings layers lies underneath when both cover the same face. It moves only these two relative to each other and never against the other material families; it is a uniform, so switching it compiles nothing. Applies immediately. [Floor layer below / Wall layer below]
NavigationReset this layercl_avfx_defaults_surface_materials_floor_surfacesReset every control of this layer to its default.

Wildlife (q2prox_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Surfaces & Water → Surface Materials → Wildlife

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionMasterMaster
ToggleMasterWildlifecl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlersWildlife family master. Creatures live on eligible static surfaces. Needs the Surface Materials master and one surface lane. Default off. Applies immediately.
ToggleMasterWallscl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_wallsLet wildlife move on eligible walls. Independent of the floor lane. Applies immediately.
ToggleMasterFloorscl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_floorsLet wildlife move on eligible floors and slopes. Independent of the wall lane. Applies immediately.
ListMasterCreaturescl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_variantChoose regional Auto, Random mixing, or one creature type. Fixed species keep stable numbers as new types are appended. Applies immediately. [Auto / Random (all) / Ants / Beetles / Spiders / Roaches / Tiny mixed insects / Sparse mixed routes / Tadpoles / Snails / Snakes]
SectionAppearanceAppearance
SliderAppearanceAlphacl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_alphaHow strongly the creatures show over the surface. 0 is a real no-op. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceDensitycl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_densityHow many routes are occupied. Lowering it removes routes without moving the rest. 0 is a real no-op. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceSizecl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_scalePhysical size of the creatures. It changes their size, not their number or where the routes run. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearancePopulationcl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_populationPeak number of creatures. It multiplies how many can appear per area; at 100 there are a hundred times more than at 1. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceVisibilitycl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contrastHow hard the creatures read against the surface. Higher darkens the body and lifts its outline, so they stay visible on bright and dark surfaces alike. Applies immediately.
SliderAppearanceSize variationcl_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_size_variationHow much individual creatures differ in size. Applies immediately.
NavigationAppearanceMovement...q2prox_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_motionOpen Movement settings: travel speed, route curvature, gait and grouping.
NavigationAppearanceColour and wall placement...q2prox_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_placeOpen Colour and wall placement: RGB tint, spread up a wall, reach and boundary softness.
NavigationAppearanceSurfaces and blood...q2prox_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_environmentOpen Snake reactions on puddles and grass, plus blood spreading after a kill.
NavigationAppearanceAudio and contacts...q2prox_avfx_surface_materials_crawlers_contactsOpen optional Snake audio and wildlife contacts with hazards and local weapons.

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint

Snake combat (single player) (q2prox_avfx_snake_combat)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Surfaces & Water → Surface Materials → Wildlife → Wildlife: audio and contacts → Snake combat (single player)

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionMasterMaster
ToggleMasterSnake combatcl_sp_avfx_snake_combatMaster switch of the optional Snake combat mode. Off is a complete no-op. Works only in local single player with the Q2PRO-X game DLL: no effect in deathmatch, coop, demo playback or on a remote server. Enabling it gives the whole mode at once, because every direction below is on by default. Default off. Applies immediately.
SectionSnake parametersSnake parameters
SliderSnake parametersSnake healthcl_sp_avfx_snake_healthSnake health against monster attacks, in hit points. It does not regenerate. Raising it does not heal a Snake that is already fighting; lowering it clamps the current value. Skill-0 value: x1/x2/x3/x4 at skill 0/1/2/3. Applies immediately.
SliderSnake parametersFighting at oncecl_sp_avfx_snake_max_engagedHow many Snakes may fight at the same time. Snakes already fighting keep their place; lowering it releases the farthest ones first, with their targets restored and no final bite. Applies immediately.
ToggleSnake parametersRequire line of sightcl_sp_avfx_snake_require_losRequire a clear line of sight before a Snake picks a target. A physical path to the target and real bite reach are always required, whatever this is set to. Applies immediately.
SliderSnake parametersBite reachcl_sp_avfx_snake_bite_reachHow close the head must be, in world units, before a bite can land. This is contact reach, not the search area. It grows safely with the visible Snake size. Applies immediately.
SectionSnakes attack monstersSnakes attack monsters
ToggleSnakes attack monstersSnakes attack monsterscl_sp_avfx_snake_attack_monstersLet Snakes acquire, approach and repeatedly bite monsters. On by default, and dormant while the master above is off. Applies immediately.
SliderSnakes attack monstersDamagecl_sp_avfx_snake_attack_monsters_damageBase damage of one hit, before armour, power armour, godmode, invulnerability and skill scaling. It is direct contact damage with no knockback. Skill-0 value: x1/x2/x3/x4 at skill 0/1/2/3. Applies immediately.
SliderSnakes attack monstersChance to fight, %cl_sp_avfx_snake_attack_monsters_chanceChance in percent that a given pair starts fighting at all. It is rolled ONCE when the pair meets, never every frame: 0 never, 100 always. Changing it affects the next meeting, not one already under way. Applies immediately.
SliderSnakes attack monstersSearch areacl_sp_avfx_snake_attack_monsters_zoneSearch area in world units. A target inside it may be chosen; touching it still needs a physical path and the bite reach. Applies immediately.
SliderSnakes attack monstersInterval, scl_sp_avfx_snake_attack_monsters_intervalMinimum time in seconds between two hits of the same fight. Applies immediately.
SectionSnakes attack the playerSnakes attack the player
ToggleSnakes attack the playerSnakes attack the playercl_sp_avfx_snake_attack_playerLet Snakes acquire, approach and repeatedly bite you. Your armour, power armour, godmode and invulnerability all apply normally. On by default. Applies immediately.
SliderSnakes attack the playerDamagecl_sp_avfx_snake_attack_player_damageBase damage of one hit, before armour, power armour, godmode, invulnerability and skill scaling. It is direct contact damage with no knockback. Skill-0 value: x1/x2/x3/x4 at skill 0/1/2/3. Applies immediately.
SliderSnakes attack the playerChance to fight, %cl_sp_avfx_snake_attack_player_chanceChance in percent that a given pair starts fighting at all. It is rolled ONCE when the pair meets, never every frame: 0 never, 100 always. Changing it affects the next meeting, not one already under way. Applies immediately.
SliderSnakes attack the playerSearch areacl_sp_avfx_snake_attack_player_zoneSearch area in world units. A target inside it may be chosen; touching it still needs a physical path and the bite reach. Applies immediately.
SliderSnakes attack the playerInterval, scl_sp_avfx_snake_attack_player_intervalMinimum time in seconds between two hits of the same fight. Applies immediately.
SectionMonsters attack SnakesMonsters attack Snakes
ToggleMonsters attack SnakesMonsters attack Snakescl_sp_avfx_monster_attack_snakesLet monsters notice a Snake on their own and attack it with their normal melee, hitscan and projectile weapons. Their current player target is never stolen. On by default. Applies immediately.
SliderMonsters attack SnakesDamagecl_sp_avfx_monster_attack_snakes_damageBase damage of one hit, before armour, power armour, godmode, invulnerability and skill scaling. It is direct contact damage with no knockback. Skill-0 value: x1/x2/x3/x4 at skill 0/1/2/3. Applies immediately.
SliderMonsters attack SnakesChance to fight, %cl_sp_avfx_monster_attack_snakes_chanceChance in percent that a given pair starts fighting at all. It is rolled ONCE when the pair meets, never every frame: 0 never, 100 always. Changing it affects the next meeting, not one already under way. Applies immediately.
SliderMonsters attack SnakesSearch areacl_sp_avfx_monster_attack_snakes_zoneSearch area in world units. A target inside it may be chosen; touching it still needs a physical path and the bite reach. Applies immediately.
SliderMonsters attack SnakesInterval, scl_sp_avfx_monster_attack_snakes_intervalMinimum time in seconds between two hits of the same fight. Applies immediately.
SectionRetaliationRetaliation
ToggleRetaliationStrike back after a bitecl_sp_avfx_monster_retaliate_snakesLet a bitten monster strike back even when monsters do not attack Snakes on their own. It opens only after a bite that really took health, targets exactly the Snake that bit, and uses the damage, interval and search area above. On by default. Applies immediately.

Enhanced AVFX (q2prox_avfx_enhanced)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → Enhanced AVFX

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
ToggleSurface effectscl_avfx_worldMaster toggle for surface effects (water enhancement, weather sky, rain splashes, water rings, snow caps); mandatory liquid particle clipping always runs. Applies immediately.
ToggleAuto-couple weathercl_avfx_world_autoAuto-link weather strength to surface effects (heavier rain/snow -> darker sky, more rings); off = each feature's manual strength only. Applies immediately.
ToggleSurface debugcl_avfx_world_debugAdd surface diagnostics to the AVFX info dump (liquid-clip stats, classifier and ring/splash/puddle/snow counters). Applies immediately.
ToggleWeapon water impactscl_avfx_weapon_impactsAVFX reactions when weapons hit real water or a visible AVFX puddle (splashes, rings, steam, dark marks, BFG evaporation). Master toggle, default off; per-weapon in submenu. Applies immediately.
NavigationPer-weapon...q2prox_avfx_weapon_impactsOpen per-weapon water-impact toggles (Blaster, Hyperblaster, Machinegun, Chaingun, Shotgun, Super Shotgun, Railgun, Grenade, Grenade Launcher, Rocket Launcher, BFG).

SliderSteam sizecl_avfx_lava_steam_sizeSteam puff diameter multiplier; applies to newly spawned puffs, not ones already floating. Applies immediately.
SliderSteam opacitycl_avfx_lava_steam_alphaSteam opacity (0 = invisible, 1 = normal); applies immediately to all puffs. Applies immediately.
SliderSteam speedcl_avfx_lava_steam_speedSteam rise speed, world units per second. Applies immediately.

AVFX Sound Volumes (q2prox_avfxvol)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Local FX & Sound → AVFX Sound Volumes

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionMasterMaster
ToggleMasterSoundscl_avfx_audioMaster gate for all AVFX sound layers (thunder, rain/wind/snow/water beds, drop ticks, ring plips, footsteps). Silent if a layer's WAV is missing. Applies immediately.
SliderMasterSound volumecl_avfx_audio_volumeOverall loudness of AVFX sound effects (multiplies s_volume and every sub-layer). Applies immediately.
SectionWeather & environmentWeather & environment
ToggleWeather & environmentWind soundcl_avfx_audio_windGate for the wind audio layer: ambient wind/dust/ash/fog loops, storm variant and gust one-shots. Silent if WAV missing. Applies immediately.
ToggleWeather & environmentRain soundcl_avfx_audio_rainGate for the main rain-noise loops (light/normal/heavy + underwater). Drop ticks and ring plips have their own gates. Silent if WAV missing. Applies immediately.
ToggleWeather & environmentRain drop soundcl_avfx_audio_rain_dropsAllow close raindrop tick sounds (rain preset only). Silent if WAV missing. Applies immediately.
ToggleWeather & environmentSnow soundcl_avfx_audio_snowGate for the snow-preset ambience: a deliberately soft winter-wind loop (snow_wind_loop.wav), not loud snow noise. Silent if WAV missing. Applies immediately.
ToggleWeather & environmentWater soundcl_avfx_audio_waterAllow ring-plip and soft water-surface sounds for AVFX water contacts (if WAVs present). Applies immediately.
ToggleWeather & environmentThundercl_avfx_audio_thunderAllow thunder sound tied to lightning events. Applies immediately.
NavigationWeather & environmentEvents & sky...q2prox_avfxvol_eventsOpen steam, sky-event, spaceship and Black-Hole sound controls.
NavigationWeather & environmentContacts & wildlife...q2prox_avfxvol_contactsOpen surface-contact and positional wildlife sound controls.
SectionServiceService
NavigationServiceAVFX sounds offset cl_avfx_audio 0Mute AVFX through its master only. Child preferences and all visual/non-AVFX settings stay untouched.
NavigationServiceRestore AVFX sound defaultscl_avfx_defaults_audioRestore every AVFX sound control to its registered default. Optional Black-Hole audio remains OFF by default.

AVFX Sounds / Events & Sky (q2prox_avfxvol_events)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Local FX & Sound → AVFX Sound Volumes → AVFX Sounds / Events & Sky

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionSteamSteam
ToggleSteamSteam soundcl_avfx_audio_lava_steamShort evaporation hiss when rain/snow hits lava; loudness scales with particle size. Visual steam is separate. Applies immediately.
ToggleSteamSurface steam soundcl_avfx_audio_lava_surface_steamSofter positional hiss from melting snow/water at lava edges (steam_surface_hiss1..3), at the soft surface-steam point. Applies immediately.
ToggleSteamSnow impact steam audiocl_avfx_weapon_snow_steam_audioSeparate steam hiss for hot weapon hits on snow. The visual steam stays part of the weapon effect. Applies immediately.
SectionCelestialCelestial
ToggleCelestialImpact bangcl_avfx_audio_impactAllow an explosion bang at the lightning strike point (rocket-style, fades with distance). Applies immediately.
ToggleCelestialImpact meteor audiocl_avfx_audio_meteor_impactFalling impact meteor audio (entry hiss, flyby whoosh, impact boom, debris). Missing WAVs silent. Applies immediately.
ToggleCelestialSky meteor audiocl_avfx_audio_meteorSky meteor audio (burnup crack). Missing WAV silent. Applies immediately.
ToggleCelestialSpaceship flyby audiocl_avfx_spaceships_soundSky spaceship flyby sound. Default ON. 0 = silent ships. Missing WAVs silent. Applies immediately.
SliderCelestialSpaceship flyby volumecl_avfx_spaceships_sound_volumeSky spaceship flyby volume. 0.35 (default). 0 = silent. Applies immediately.
ToggleCelestialBlack Hole audiocl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_audioBlack Hole presence sound: a deep gravitational bed that grows with the hole's APPARENT size, plus a shear layer positioned toward the hole. Requires AVFX audio and a visible Black Hole; independent of the optional consumption master. Default OFF. Missing WAVs silent. Applies immediately.
SliderCelestialBlack Hole volumecl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_audio_volumeBlack Hole presence volume before the global AVFX gain. 0.70 (default). Applies immediately.
SliderCelestialView focuscl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_audio_focusHow much looking at the hole lifts the shear layer. The hole stays audible behind you: this shapes the mix, it never mutes it. 0.30 (default). Applies immediately.
ToggleCelestialBlack Hole eventscl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_audio_eventsBounded Black Hole events: object in-draw, celestial shear and positional rock fracture from Surface Lift. Bursts use fixed voice/cooldown limits. Default OFF. Applies immediately.
SliderCelestialBlack Hole event volumecl_avfx_blackhole_consumption_audio_events_volumeVolume of the Black Hole in-draw and shear events, before the global AVFX gain. Independent of the presence bed volume. 0.80 (default). Applies immediately.
NavigationCelestialBackq2prox_avfxvolBack to master, weather and contact AVFX sounds.
