Lightning Settings (q2prox_avfx_lightning_settings)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Weather & Atmosphere → Lightning Settings

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionBasic settingsBasic settings
ToggleBasic settingsLightningcl_avfx_lightningAllow visual lightning flashes while a storm is active. Live. Applies immediately.
SliderBasic settingsLightning frequencycl_avfx_lightning_frequencyLightning frequency multiplier: 8.1 = default, 0.1 = rare distant flashes. Higher packs strikes tighter but the rate floors near ~0.3 s, so 4..100 look about the same. Live. Applies immediately.
SliderBasic settingsLightning durationcl_avfx_lightning_durationLightning duration multiplier: 1.8 = ~180 ms default, up to 10 = ~1.8 s bolt, 0.1 = ~30 ms flicker. Live. Applies immediately.
ToggleBasic settingsScreen flashcl_avfx_lightning_screen_flashScreen flash on strike. Off keeps the bolt and impact blast but removes the full-screen tint. Live. Applies immediately.
SliderBasic settingsLightning impact sizecl_avfx_lightning_impact_scaleSize of the blast at the strike point: 0 = no blast, 5 = default and largest. Lower shrinks it (halved on water). Live. Applies immediately.
ToggleBasic settingsImpact dlightcl_avfx_lightning_impact_dlightWarm dynamic light at the strike point (particles / smoke / screen flash unaffected). Live. Applies immediately.
SectionRealistic lifecycleRealistic lifecycle
ToggleRealistic lifecycleRealistic lightningcl_avfx_lightning_realisticRealistic lightning lifecycle: thin/dim leader from sky, brightness/thickness peak, fade-out. Default on. 0 falls back to the old constant-brightness look for comparison. Applies immediately.
SliderRealistic lifecycleLeader phasecl_avfx_lightning_leader_ratioLeader-phase fraction of total strike duration: bolt is dim/thin until life exceeds this ratio. Tighter values (0.1) feel almost instantaneous; larger (0.4) shows a longer descent. Applies immediately.
SliderRealistic lifecyclePeak timingcl_avfx_lightning_peak_ratioPeak-timing fraction of total strike duration: brightness/thickness reach maximum at this point. Screen flash peak syncs to the same moment. Must be greater than leader. Applies immediately.
SliderRealistic lifecycleBolt widthcl_avfx_lightning_widthBolt width multiplier — applies to ALL lightning structures: trunk, branches, surface arcs, bloom halo and glow corona. Default 0.15 gives a thin photo-realistic bolt. Up to 1.5 thickens; minimum 0.01 = barely visible filament. Step 0.01 for fine tuning. Applies immediately.
SliderRealistic lifecycleBolt glowcl_avfx_lightning_glowOuter-glow intensity around the inner core (blue/violet halo). 0 disables glow; 1.5 gives a strong electric corona; higher reads as exaggerated bloom. Applies immediately.
SliderRealistic lifecycleBranch densitycl_avfx_lightning_branch_densityBranch arc density. 0 disables branch arcs; 1.0 emits all generated branches. Higher values are clamped to the generated count. Applies immediately.
SectionBloom & glowBloom & glow
ToggleBloom & glowLightning glowcl_avfx_lightning_bloomLightning bloom halo around the bolt: broad halo / overexposed light mass. With force-post enabled, AVFX lightning can use its own post-bloom path even when global bloom is disabled. Synced with bolt brightness envelope + optional afterglow tail. Applies immediately.
SliderBloom & glowBloom intensitycl_avfx_lightning_bloom_intensityBloom halo overall intensity. 0 disables; 1.5 (default) baseline; up to 5.0 for cinematic storms. Applies immediately.
SliderBloom & glowBloom radiuscl_avfx_lightning_bloom_radiusBloom halo radius / width multiplier. 0.25 = thin halo close to bolt; 1.0 (default) baseline; up to 4.0 = wide overexposed mass. Applies immediately.
SliderBloom & glowBloom layerscl_avfx_lightning_bloom_layersNumber of additive halo layers around the bolt. 1 = single thin halo; 3 (default) = three concentric layers; up to 5 for rich glow mass. Outer layers skip first under budget pressure. Applies immediately.
SliderBloom & glowBloom afterglowcl_avfx_lightning_bloom_afterglowAfterglow tail as fraction of bolt duration. 0 = no tail (bloom dies with bolt); 0.2 (default) ≈ 20%. Up to 1.0 = same duration again as luminous afterimage. Smoothstep fade. Applies immediately.
ToggleBloom & glowForce-post bloomcl_avfx_lightning_bloom_force_postRenderer-forced lightning bloom: keep bloom MRT alive even when global gl_bloom is off so lightning halo uses true post-bloom (downsample/blur/composite). When gl_bloom is already on this is a no-op (no double-bloom). Cvars unchanged when off (legacy additive halo behavior). Applies immediately.
SliderBloom & glowBranch levelscl_avfx_lightning_branch_levelsMaximum branch hierarchy depth. 0 = trunk only, no branches at all. 1 (default) = level-1 branches only (foundation tree-from-trunk topology — clean accepted look). 2..4 = recursive child branches up to that depth (busier visual; opt-in). Applies immediately.
SliderBloom & glowChild forkingcl_avfx_lightning_branch_forkingChild fork amount multiplier for level 2+ branches. 0 disables child forks (level-1 branches only). 1.0 (Default) baseline; up to 3.0 = many child forks. Per-parent fork count = clamp(round(2.0 × forking × decay^(level-1)), 0, 5). Applies immediately.
SliderBloom & glowLevel decaycl_avfx_lightning_branch_decayPer-level decay of width / brightness / length / fork count. 0.35 = rapid attenuation (deep levels barely visible); 0.62 (default) baseline. 0.85 = Slow attenuation (deep levels nearly as bright as parent). Applies immediately.
SliderBloom & glowBranch spreadcl_avfx_lightning_branch_spreadLateral spread / length multiplier for child branches. 0.25 = tight tree near trunk; 1.0 (default) baseline; up to 3.0 = wide far-reaching branches. Applies immediately.

NavigationSubmenusLightning discharges & damage...q2prox_avfx_lightning_dischargesOpen lightning discharges & damage: surface arcs, water reaction, monster arcs + death FX, and lightning damage to monsters/objects.

Lightning Discharges & Damage (q2prox_avfx_lightning_discharges)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Weather & Atmosphere → Lightning Discharges & Damage

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionSurface arcsSurface arcs
ToggleSurface arcsSurface electric arcscl_avfx_lightning_surface_arcsDecorative electric arcs crawling from the strike point (visual only, no damage). Synced to the bolt brightness; needs Realistic lightning. Live. Applies immediately.
SliderSurface arcsArc radiuscl_avfx_lightning_surface_arc_radiusMaximum crawl radius around the impact point in world units. Higher values spread the arcs further across the impacted surface. Applies immediately.
SliderSurface arcsArc densitycl_avfx_lightning_surface_arc_densityArc count / branch density. 1.0 (default) emits ~5 arcs per strike; 0 disables. Higher values up to 3.0 are clamped to the per-strike arc cap. Applies immediately.
SliderSurface arcsArc brightnesscl_avfx_lightning_surface_arc_intensityArc brightness / alpha multiplier. 1.0 (default) baseline; higher values brighten arcs; 0 disables. Applies immediately.
SliderSurface arcsArc widthcl_avfx_lightning_surface_arc_widthArc width multiplier (per segment). 1.0 (default) baseline ~3px equivalent; higher values thicken the arcs. Applies immediately.
SectionImpact particlesImpact particles
NavigationImpact particlesLightning impact particles...q2prox_avfx_lightning_discharge_particlesOpen the independent Enable and RGB controls for debris emitted at the lightning strike point.
SectionWater reactionsWater reactions
ToggleWater reactionsLightning water reactioncl_avfx_lightning_water_reactMaster: when lightning strikes water (real BSP water or visible AVFX puddles), spawn steam, splash particles, and ripple rings. Visual only. Applies immediately.
ToggleWater reactionsLightning water steamcl_avfx_lightning_water_steamSteam / vapor plumes at the lightning-water contact point. Disable separately from the other water effects. Applies immediately.
ToggleWater reactionsLightning water splashescl_avfx_lightning_water_splashesSplash particles thrown up from the water surface where lightning hits or crawls. Disable separately. Applies immediately.
ToggleWater reactionsLightning water ringscl_avfx_lightning_water_ringsConcentric rings on the water surface from lightning impact and crawling arcs. Disable separately. Applies immediately.
SliderWater reactionsWater reaction amountcl_avfx_lightning_water_react_amountOverall intensity multiplier for water reaction effects (1.0 default; 0..3). Applies immediately.
SliderWater reactionsWater reaction radiuscl_avfx_lightning_water_react_radiusEffect radius for water rings in world units (default 96 = baseline; 16..256 wu). Wet detection itself is point-based and unaffected. Applies immediately.
SectionMonster effectsMonster effects
ToggleMonster effectsMonster electric wrapscl_avfx_lightning_monster_arcsElectric arcs wrap around monsters damaged by lightning + cool blue glow dlight. Visual only — never adds damage. Requires Realistic lightning + lightning damage enabled to trigger. Applies immediately.
SliderMonster effectsMonster wrap intensitycl_avfx_lightning_monster_arc_intensityWrap arc brightness / dlight intensity multiplier. 1.0 default; higher brightens both arcs and the glow. Applies immediately.
ToggleMonster effectsLightning corpse effectscl_avfx_lightning_monster_corpse_fxWhen a monster dies from lightning: brief warm fire-flash at corpse + dark spot fading over several seconds. Visual only. Applies immediately.
SectionDamage & resetDamage & reset
ToggleDamage & resetLightning damages monsterscl_sp_avfx_lightning_damageLightning radial-damages nearby monsters in local single-player and DM-training. Off by default. No effect in deathmatch / coop / demos / remote multiplayer. Player and items not damaged. Bosses included by default. Applies immediately.
SliderDamage & resetLightning damage amountcl_sp_avfx_lightning_damage_amountDamage at strike center (rocket-class default 120). Falls off to ~25% at the radius edge. Tougher monsters survive more strikes. Applies immediately.
SliderDamage & resetLightning damage radiuscl_sp_avfx_lightning_damage_radiusDamage radius in world units (default 800, ~5x grenade launcher splash). Damage falls off with distance from strike center. Applies immediately.
ToggleDamage & resetRequire line of sightcl_sp_avfx_lightning_damage_losRequire line-of-sight from strike point to monster center: lightning does not hurt monsters behind thick walls (MASK_SOLID trace). Applies immediately.
ToggleDamage & resetLightning breaks objectscl_sp_avfx_lightning_damage_breakablesAllow AVFX lightning to damage nearby explosive barrels (misc_explobox) and breakable func_explosive brushes using the same amount/radius/falloff settings as monster lightning damage. Off by default. Doors, buttons, triggers and scripted entities are never affected. Applies immediately.
NavigationDamage & resetReset to defaultscl_avfx_defaults_lightning_dischargesReset every parameter in this submenu to its default value.

SliderSun diskSun: bluecl_avfx_sun_color_bSun color blue. Applies immediately.

SectionLightingLighting
ToggleLightingSun lightingcl_avfx_sun_lightingSun scene lighting. Applies immediately.
SliderLightingSun lighting multipliercl_avfx_sun_lighting_multiplierBoosts sun lighting on AVFX water/snow/puddles/rain only (world and sky unaffected). 1 = previous, 5 = default, up to 20; keeps puddles bright at a low, sky-safe sun brightness. Applies immediately.
SliderLightingSun world lightcl_avfx_sun_world_lightSun world light. Applies immediately.
SliderLightingSun entity lightcl_avfx_sun_entity_lightSun entity light. Applies immediately.
SliderLightingSun indoor leakcl_avfx_sun_indoor_leakSun light fraction that leaks indoors. 0.90 (default) = strong accepted leak. 0 = no leak when sky invisible (outdoor unchanged). 1 = indoor matches outdoor celestial. Smooth ~300 ms transition. Applies immediately.
SectionSun raysSun rays
ToggleSun raysGod rays / Sun shaftscl_avfx_sun_godraysAVFX god rays / sun shafts master toggle. Screen-space radial blur from sun's projected screen position. Independent from gl_bloom. Off by default. Applies immediately.
SliderSun raysGod rays intensitycl_avfx_sun_godrays_intensityGod rays overall intensity multiplier. 1.45 (default) baseline; 0 = invisible; up to 2.0 for cinematic strong rays. Multiplies the final visibility envelope (horizon × front × screen × cloud × sun brightness). Applies immediately.
SliderSun raysGod rays densitycl_avfx_sun_godrays_densitySample spacing / density along radial-blur direction (GPU Gems density). 0.85 (default); lower = tighter rays close to sun; higher = longer streaks across screen. Applies immediately.
SliderSun raysGod rays decaycl_avfx_sun_godrays_decayPer-sample falloff multiplier (GPU Gems decay). 0.91 (default) smooth gradual fade; lower = faster fade (tighter rays). 1.0 = No decay (rays extend uniformly — usually too bright). Applies immediately.
SliderSun raysGod rays weightcl_avfx_sun_godrays_weightPer-sample brightness weight (GPU Gems weight). 0.55 (default) natural ray strength; higher brightens each sample; lower weakens. Applies immediately.
SliderSun raysGod rays exposurecl_avfx_sun_godrays_exposureFinal exposure on the accumulated radial-blur result (GPU Gems exposure). 0.15 (default) tasteful glow; higher produces overexposed rays. Applies immediately.
SliderSun raysGod rays samplescl_avfx_sun_godrays_samplesNumber of radial-blur sample taps per fragment. 51 (default) balanced quality/cost. Higher smoother continuous streaks; lower banded but cheaper. GPU cost ≈ linear in samples × screen pixels. Applies immediately.
SliderSun raysGod rays cloud maskcl_avfx_sun_godrays_cloud_maskHow strongly clouds mask god rays. 0 = clouds do not affect rays; 0.90 (default) = accepted smoothed cloud attenuation. Set below 1 to keep rays visible through light overcast. Applies immediately.

Black Hole: Object Capture (q2prox_avfx_blackhole_capture)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Sky & Celestials → Black Hole → Black Hole: Consumption → Black Hole: Object Capture

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionMainMain
ToggleMainObject capturecl_avfx_blackhole_capture_objectsObject-capture master. OFF = zero work; every meteor and comet keeps its exact baseline flight. Needs the consumption master on, an object child below enabled, and a Black Hole present. The separate celestial-matter parent is not required. Applies immediately.
SectionObjectsObjects
ToggleObjectsMeteorscl_avfx_blackhole_capture_meteorsCapture ordinary flying sky meteors. A captured meteor stops burning up on its own and curves into the core. No flying meteors on screen means no effect. Applies immediately.
ToggleObjectsCometscl_avfx_blackhole_capture_cometsCapture comets. The nucleus/coma follows the curved path while the single continuous streak bends after it. The whole comet contracts into the core. No comets on screen means no effect. Applies immediately.
ToggleObjectsSpaceshipscl_avfx_blackhole_capture_spaceshipsCapture local AVFX sky spaceships. A ship on its normal route bends into the same curved capture path, keeps its nose on its true motion, then contracts and fades into the dark core. Needs the object-capture master (and its parents) plus sky spaceships enabled. Off by default. Applies immediately.
ToggleObjectsImpact meteorscl_avfx_blackhole_capture_impact_meteorsCapture FALLING impact meteors, but only while still pre-terminal. A meteor already colliding or completing its descent this frame always impacts normally. Captured ones leave no impact, shake, damage bridge or crater. Off by default. Applies immediately.
SectionBehaviourBehaviour
SliderBehaviourCapture radiuscl_avfx_blackhole_capture_radiusAttraction-zone reach: how close an object must pass before it latches on. Larger values capture from farther away. Applies immediately.
SliderBehaviourCapture speedcl_avfx_blackhole_capture_speedCapture speed: how fast a latched object is drawn into the core. Bounded so a moving hole can never make an object immortal. Applies immediately.
SliderBehaviourSpiralcl_avfx_blackhole_capture_spiralSpiral amount: how much a captured object curls around the hole instead of falling straight in. 0 is a straight bend. Applies immediately.
SliderBehaviourDissolvecl_avfx_blackhole_capture_dissolveCore dissolve envelope: how early and wide the near-core shrink and fade begins. Applies immediately.
SectionServiceService
NavigationServiceReset this sectioncl_avfx_defaults_blackhole_captureReset the object-capture master, the meteor/comet children and the behaviour controls to defaults.

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
ToggleSun lightingcl_avfx_volclouds_sun_lightingSun forward-scatter lighting (silver lining). Default ON. Applies immediately.
ToggleMoon lightingcl_avfx_volclouds_moon_lightingWeak cold moon contribution at night. Default ON. Applies immediately.
SliderSilver liningcl_avfx_volclouds_silver_liningSilver lining (HG anisotropy g). 0=isotropic; 0.20 (default) = gentle forward-scatter bias. Applies immediately.
SliderAmbientcl_avfx_volclouds_ambientAmbient light floor for clouds. 0.50 (default) = balanced night readability without washing out the sky. Applies immediately.
SliderStorm darkeningcl_avfx_volclouds_storm_darkeningStorm darkening strength (applies only when volclouds AND cl_avfx_storm both on). 0.25 (default). Applies immediately.
ToggleSun/moon disk occlusioncl_avfx_volclouds_sun_occlusionSun/moon disk occlusion. Default OFF: celestial disks keep their tuned visibility while flat-cloud occlusion still applies. Applies immediately.
SliderLighting maskcl_avfx_volclouds_lighting_maskHow strongly volclouds dim sun/moon world/entity lighting (independent of disk occlusion and god rays mask). 1.0 (default) = full physical dimming; 0 = no scene-lighting effect. Applies immediately.
SliderWorld shadowcl_avfx_volclouds_world_shadowClouds over the sun dim the world baseline (matches the visible clouds). 1.25 (default); up to 3.0 cinematic; 0 = off. Applies globally. Applies immediately.
SliderTemporal jittercl_avfx_volclouds_temporal_jitterPer-frame golden-ratio sub-step phase jitter for the cloud raymarch. Values above 0 can add edge shimmer on thin cloud boundaries; raise sparingly. Default 0 (off). Applies immediately.
ToggleLocal lightning illumcl_avfx_volclouds_lightning_localLocal lightning illumination. Nearby strikes brighten the cloud body within radius rather than uniformly across the sky. Sparse-sampled every 4th raymarch step. Applies immediately.
SliderLocal light radiuscl_avfx_volclouds_lightning_local_radiusHorizontal radius of the bounded cloud-entry glow at each bolt. 1200 default; lower = tighter glow per strike, higher = broader storm flash that may overlap. Applies immediately.
SliderLocal light strengthcl_avfx_volclouds_lightning_local_strengthBrightness boost of the cloud-entry glow. 4 default; up to 5.0 cinematic over-bright at the strike. Applies immediately.
SliderLocal light falloffcl_avfx_volclouds_lightning_local_falloffRadial edge softness inside the cloud-entry glow. 1.0 linear; 1.25 default; higher = tighter core; lower = nearly uniform. Applies immediately.

Sound & Acoustics (q2prox_sound)

Path: Main menu → Quick Setup → Sound & Acoustics

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionEngine & outputEngine & output
ListEngine & outputSound engines_enableSound engine: no sound / software (DMA) / OpenAL. OpenAL is required for al_profile, HRTF and room acoustics. Applies immediately. [no sound / software / OpenAL]
ListEngine & outputSound profileal_sound_profilePreset acoustics recipe; editing any reverb value by hand switches this to Custom. Applies immediately. [custom / competitive / balanced / immersive / cinematic / cathedral]
ListEngine & outputOutput rates_khzSound output sample rate (kHz); higher = better quality. Restarts the sound engine when changed. Applies immediately. [11 / 22 / 44 / 48 / 96]
ListEngine & outputSample formats_sampleformatOutput sample format: auto, 16-bit int or 32-bit float. Restarts the sound engine when changed. Applies immediately. [auto / s16 / float32]
ListEngine & outputOpenAL profileal_profileOpenAL tuning profile: Q2PRO-X spatialization vs. R1Q2-like attenuation. Restarts the sound engine. Applies immediately. [Q2PRO-X / R1Q2-like]
ListEngine & outputHRTFal_hrtfHRTF binaural mixing for headphones (OpenAL): off / auto / on. Restarts the sound engine when changed. Applies immediately. [off / auto / on]
ListEngine & outputOpenAL resampleral_resamplerOpenAL per-source resampler quality (higher = cleaner pitch-shifting, a bit more CPU). Restarts the sound engine. Applies immediately. [default / cubic / bsinc12 / bsinc24 / point / linear]
ListEngine & outputDMA resamplers_resamplerSoftware (DMA) engine resampler quality; affects only the non-OpenAL path. Restarts the sound engine. Applies immediately. [legacy / linear / cubic]
SectionReverb & acousticsReverb & acoustics
ToggleReverb & acousticsReverberation supportal_reverbMaster switch for OpenAL EFX room-acoustics reverb; off = dry sound. Applies immediately.
ListReverb & acousticsReverb presetal_eax_presetReverb preset for the current zone: Auto runs the per-zone classifier. The rest force a fixed room type. Applies immediately. [auto / generic / small / medium / hall / corridor / outdoor / underwater]
SliderReverb & acousticsReverb wetal_eax_wetReverb send level (master wet mix): 0 = dry, 1 = full reverb. Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsLocal wetal_eax_local_wetReverb wet level for your own sounds (footsteps, jumps, landings); usually lower so they stay present. Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsLerp timeal_reverb_lerp_timeSmoothing time (sec) when reverb changes between zones. Higher = smoother but more audible lag. Applies immediately.
ToggleReverb & acousticsOcclusional_eax_occlusionMuffle sounds behind walls with a low-pass filter (occlusion). More realism, a little more audio CPU. Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsExplosion wetal_eax_explosion_wetReverb wet override for explosions, so big booms echo differently from normal sounds. Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsExplosion decayal_eax_explosion_decayReverb decay-time override for explosions; longer decay makes booms feel grander. Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsExplosion lateal_eax_explosion_lateLate-reflection (tail) gain override for explosions; boosts the tail on big booms. Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsTransport wetal_eax_transport_wetReverb wet override for UI / broadcast cues (pickups, centerprint beeps); usually low so they stay crisp. Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsReflectionsal_reverb_reflectionsEarly-reflection gain: volume of the first few bounces of the reverb response. Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsLate reverbal_reverb_lateLate-reflection gain: volume of the reverb tail after the early reflections. Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsDecayal_reverb_decayReverb tail decay time (sec): larger = longer echo (cathedral), smaller = short (small room). Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsDelayal_reverb_delayReverb pre-delay (sec): gap between the dry sound and the first reflections. Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsHF brightnessal_reverb_hfReverb high-frequency gain; lower dampens highs in the tail (soft surfaces / carpet). Applies immediately.
SliderReverb & acousticsDiffusional_reverb_diffusionReverb diffusion (reflection density): low = sparse/fluttery, high = smooth dense reverb. Applies immediately.
ToggleReverb & acousticsReverb debugal_eax_debugPrint EAX reverb diagnostics on every preset change (zone, preset name, params). Noisy; for tuning only. Applies immediately.
SectionBehaviorBehavior
ToggleBehaviorMute when inactives_mute_when_inactiveMute audio when the game window loses focus (Alt-Tab), so it doesn't bleed into other apps. Applies immediately.
SectionActionsActions
NavigationActionsReverb info...al_reverb_infoPrint the current reverb classifier result and active preset to the console.
NavigationActionsReload reverb...al_reverb_reloadReload the active reverb preset (re-applies it after editing presets).
NavigationActionsResampler list...al_resampler_listList the OpenAL resamplers available on this system to the console.
NavigationActionsActive sound channels...soundactivePrint active sound channels + AVFX ambient loops
NavigationActionsRestart sound...snd_restartRestart the sound engine to apply engine / HRTF / profile changes.

Advanced Network (q2prox_advanced_network)

Path: Main menu → Online Play Setup → Advanced Network

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionBandwidthBandwidth
SliderBandwidthBandwidth rateraterate: bandwidth your client requests from the server, bytes/sec. Server may cap it. Typical modern broadband: 25000..100000. Server-visible userinfo cvar. Applies immediately.
SliderBandwidthMessage sizemsgmsg: server message size hint. 0 = small, 1 = normal (default), 2 = large. Some servers reject high values. Applies immediately.
SectionFramerateFramerate
SliderFramerateClient FPS limitcl_maxfpscl_maxfps: client framerate cap. 0 = uncapped. The renderer can still produce more frames if cl_async 1 is set. Applies immediately.
SliderFramerateRenderer FPS limitr_maxfpsr_maxfps: renderer-only framerate cap. Applies when cl_async 1; otherwise cl_maxfps is the gate. Applies immediately.
SectionRecent serversRecent servers
ToggleRecent serversAuto-connect last servercl_reconnect_last_server_autoAutomatically connect to the newest successfully played remote server on an otherwise idle cold start. Disabled by default; explicit +map, +connect, demo, URL or alias startup always wins. Applies immediately.
SliderRecent serversRecent server historycl_reconnect_history_limitNumber of unique successfully played remote servers retained globally across all mods: 0 disables and clears history, 1 keeps only the last server, the default is 10, and 100 is the maximum. Applies immediately.
NavigationRecent serversReconnect nowreconnectReconnect to the current process endpoint, or to the newest successfully played remote server when this is a fresh process.
SectionPackets & syncPackets & sync
SliderPackets & syncClient packets / seccl_maxpacketscl_maxpackets: max user-command packets per second sent to the server (10..125). Higher = more responsive but more upload bandwidth. Applies immediately.
SliderPackets & syncServer updates / seccl_updateratecl_updaterate: requested server updates per second (10..30 typical). Some servers cap it. Applies immediately.
ListPackets & syncAsync modecl_asynccl_async: 0 = synchronous client/render loop; 1 = asynchronous render loop (default). 2 = Asynchronous render loop with GPU sync fence where supported. Applies immediately. [Sync / Async / Async + GPU sync]
TogglePackets & syncInstant packetcl_instantpacketcl_instantpacket: send a usercmd packet immediately after a button press instead of waiting for the next tick. Reduces input latency by up to one packet interval. Applies immediately.
SectionUDP port autoprobeUDP port autoprobe
ListUDP port autoprobeAuto-select client UDP portcl_net_clientport_autoprobeAuto-select the client UDP port: off, RTT (fast pre-connect challenge-RTT probe), or Full scan (live-session scan over 20 candidate ports). Applies immediately. [off / RTT / Full scan]
SliderUDP port autoprobeAuto-port safety watchdogcl_net_clientport_autoprobe_timeSafety watchdog (0.1..180 s) that aborts probing if it runs too long. RTT finishes early; a full-scan run wants 60..180 s, below ~30 s warns. Applies immediately.
SliderUDP port autoprobeRTT candidate countcl_net_clientport_autoprobe_portsRTT candidate port count (2..60). Does not apply to Full scan (fixed 20 slots). Wider sweeps don't slow RTT. Default 6. Applies immediately.
ToggleUDP port autoprobeFull-scan indicatorcl_net_clientport_autoprobe_indicatorShow a blinking AUTO-PORT SCAN indicator while the full scan runs (no effect on RTT). Applies immediately.
ToggleUDP port autoprobeAutoport console logcl_net_clientport_autoprobe_verbosePrint autoport progress to the console (slot switches, samples, winner, abort). Off = runs silently. Applies immediately.
SliderUDP port autoprobeFull-scan pre-scan gracecl_net_clientport_autoprobe_settle_msOptional grace window (0..10000 ms) before the full scan applies its first slot. Raise only on slow-precache mods. Counts inside the watchdog. Applies immediately.

Scripts / Binds (q2prox_scripts)

Path: Main menu → Options → Advanced Q2PRO-X → Scripts / Binds

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionUtilityUtility
KeyUtilityWeapon drop modifier+dropwBind: hold so weapon-select binds drop the weapon instead of switching to it.
KeyUtilityFollow console IPfollowipBind: connect to the last IP address printed in the console.
KeyUtilityScore dump to consoleaadumpBind: dump the current scoreboard to the console.
KeyUtilityScore dump to fileaashotBind: save the current scoreboard to a file.
SectionMatchMatch
KeyMatchReadyreadyBind: signal Ready during match warmup.
KeyMatchUnreadyunreadyBind: cancel your Ready status during warmup.
KeyMatchVote yesvote yesBind: cast a Yes vote on the current callvote.
KeyMatchVote novote noBind: cast a No vote on the current callvote.

General and blood (q2prox_avfx_contact_general)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Local FX & Sound → Player Contact Effects → General and blood

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
TogglePlayer Contact Effectscl_avfx_contactMaster switch for the whole Player Contact layer. It is a child of the AVFX master, and off means exactly zero work. Applies immediately.
ListQualitycl_avfx_contact_qualityDetail and per-frame budget of the contact layer. Each tier carries its own immutable ceilings on droplets, collision probes, model marks, world blood, impact marks and vapor; your own caps below can only lower them, never raise them. Applies immediately. [Low / Basic / High / Extra]
SliderMaximum distancecl_avfx_contact_distanceContacts farther than this from the camera are not submitted for drawing. Lower values keep a busy fight cheap without changing what actually happened. Applies immediately.
SliderDetail scalecl_avfx_contact_lodScales the AMOUNT of everything the layer emits, inside the hard caps. Below 1.00 it thins satellites, smoke lobes and collision probes first, and the immediate hit feedback last. Applies immediately.
ToggleBloodcl_avfx_contact_bloodFamily switch for every blood visual: model wounds, airborne spray, world stains, water response and corpse pools. Off keeps the stock Quake II blood; it does not hide flesh hits. Applies immediately.
ToggleWounds on modelscl_avfx_contact_blood_modelIrregular wounds projected onto the opponent's model at the real hit point. They follow the animation instead of sliding, and expire on their own lifetime or when the model changes. Applies immediately.
ToggleSprays and fountainscl_avfx_contact_blood_sprayBallistic blood in the air: droplets, filaments and mist thrown from the wound. Sustained fire builds a repeated fountain and it decays naturally after you release the trigger. Applies immediately.
ToggleStains on the worldcl_avfx_contact_blood_surfaceSplashes, stains and running drips on real floors and walls, clipped to the actual surface so nothing hangs over an edge or runs through a wall. Applies immediately.
ToggleCorpse poolscl_avfx_contact_blood_corpseWound-fed leakage and a growing pool under a body, released only when death is actually proven. A disappearance on its own is never treated as a death, so no phantom pool appears. Applies immediately.
ToggleBlood in water and puddlescl_avfx_contact_blood_waterBlood reaching real BSP water spreads as a short-lived dye film on the animated liquid surface; blood reaching an existing AVFX puddle stays inside its real boundary and ripples it. Applies immediately.
SliderBlood colour: redcl_avfx_contact_blood_rRed channel of the blood colour. The same colour is used for model wounds, airborne blood and world stains; lighting may darken it but never replaces it. Applies immediately.
SliderBlood colour: greencl_avfx_contact_blood_gGreen channel of the blood colour. The same colour is used for model wounds, airborne blood and world stains; lighting may darken it but never replaces it. Applies immediately.
SliderBlood colour: bluecl_avfx_contact_blood_bBlue channel of the blood colour. The same colour is used for model wounds, airborne blood and world stains; lighting may darken it but never replaces it. Applies immediately.
SliderBlood opacitycl_avfx_contact_blood_alphaBase opacity of every blood visual before age and lighting are applied. Applies immediately.
SliderBlood amountcl_avfx_contact_blood_amountGlobal multiplier on how much blood a contact produces. It scales the emission, not the size of a single droplet. Applies immediately.
SliderBlood sizecl_avfx_contact_blood_sizeScales droplets, wounds and stains together. Applies immediately.
SliderSpray velocitycl_avfx_contact_blood_velocityInitial speed of the blood leaving the wound. Higher values throw it farther before gravity and drag take over. Applies immediately.
SliderGravitycl_avfx_contact_blood_gravityHow strongly airborne blood falls. 0.00 leaves it floating along its initial direction. Applies immediately.
SliderAir dragcl_avfx_contact_blood_dragHow quickly airborne blood loses speed. Higher values make short, heavy spatter; lower values make long filaments. Applies immediately.
SliderSpreadcl_avfx_contact_blood_spreadAngular width of the spray around the impact direction. Applies immediately.
SliderViscositycl_avfx_contact_blood_viscosityHow thickly blood spreads and runs on a surface. Higher values keep it tight and slow; lower values let it spread wide and thin. Applies immediately.
SliderSustained fire gaincl_avfx_contact_blood_sustainedHow much continuous fire on the same target builds the fountain. 0.00 makes every hit independent. Applies immediately.
SliderCorpse flow ratecl_avfx_contact_blood_corpse_flowHow fast the stored blood leaves a proven corpse and feeds its pool. Applies immediately.
SliderWound lifetimecl_avfx_contact_blood_model_lifetimeHow long a wound stays on a living model. 0 disables model wounds entirely and purges the ones already there. Applies immediately.
SliderStain lifetimecl_avfx_contact_blood_surface_lifetimeHow long a blood stain stays on the world. 0 disables persistent stains and purges the ones already there. Applies immediately.
SliderCorpse pool lifetimecl_avfx_contact_blood_corpse_lifetimeHow long a corpse pool and its leak stay. 0 disables corpse pools entirely. Applies immediately.

Marks and vaporization (q2prox_avfx_contact_decals_vapor)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Local FX & Sound → Player Contact Effects → Marks and vaporization

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
ToggleWeapon surface markscl_avfx_contact_decalsWeapon- and material-specific impact marks on world surfaces: punctures, pellet clusters, plasma char, rail grooves and blast soot. Each mark is clipped to the real surface and never crosses an edge or a wall. Applies immediately.
SliderMark opacitycl_avfx_contact_decal_alphaBase opacity of every weapon impact mark. Applies immediately.
SliderMark sizecl_avfx_contact_decal_sizeGlobal multiplier on the size of every weapon impact mark. Applies immediately.
SliderMaterial responsecl_avfx_contact_decal_roughnessHow strongly a mark takes on the surface it landed on. Higher values deepen the difference between a dry wall, wet stone and metal. Applies immediately.
SliderMark lifetimecl_avfx_contact_decal_lifetimeHow long a weapon impact mark stays. 0 disables persistent marks and purges the ones already there; the transient stock impact feedback is kept either way. Applies immediately.
ToggleWeapon vaporizationcl_avfx_contact_vaporizeEnable configured weapon vapor effects. Vaporization adds residue, smoke and heat; it never disables independently configured blood. Applies immediately.
SliderResidue amountcl_avfx_contact_vapor_residueHow much scorched residue a vaporizing hit leaves on the target and the nearest valid surface. Applies immediately.
SliderResidue lifetimecl_avfx_contact_vapor_residue_lifetimeHow long vaporization residue stays. 0 disables it. Applies immediately.
SliderSmoke amountcl_avfx_contact_vapor_smokeHow many smoke lobes rise from a vaporized target. Applies immediately.
SliderSmoke lifetimecl_avfx_contact_vapor_smoke_lifetimeHow long each smoke lobe lives. 0 disables the smoke. Applies immediately.
SliderSmoke rise heightcl_avfx_contact_vapor_smoke_heightHow high the smoke climbs above the body volume. Applies immediately.
ToggleHeat shimmercl_avfx_contact_vapor_heat_hazeShort-lived air distortion over a vaporized body. It is optional by backend capability: where the renderer cannot provide it, the rest of the vaporization is unchanged and nothing is substituted. Applies immediately.

Surface debris (q2prox_avfx_contact_debris)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Local FX & Sound → Player Contact Effects → Surface debris

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
ToggleSurface debriscl_avfx_contact_debrisPhysical chips and fragments thrown from the real impact surface. The amount and size remain weapon-specific below. Applies immediately.
SliderGlobal debris amountcl_avfx_contact_debris_amountGlobal multiplier for every weapon's debris count. Applies immediately.
SliderGlobal debris sizecl_avfx_contact_debris_sizeGlobal multiplier for fragment size, independent from count. Applies immediately.
SliderDebris lifetimecl_avfx_contact_debris_lifetimeHow long airborne surface fragments remain visible. Applies immediately.
SliderDebris gravitycl_avfx_contact_debris_gravityGravity multiplier for surface fragments. Applies immediately.

Blood reflections (q2prox_avfx_contact_reflections)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Local FX & Sound → Player Contact Effects → Blood reflections

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
ToggleBlood-pool scene reflection (SSR)cl_avfx_contact_blood_scene_reflectionReal screen-space reflection in horizontal blood sheets. Blood owns one SSR layer on BSP and Surface Materials; on AVFX puddles or water it inherits the existing liquid reflection to prevent a duplicate pass. Applies immediately.
SliderScene reflection strengthcl_avfx_contact_blood_scene_reflection_strengthStrength of the world/static SSR contribution in blood. Applies immediately.
ListScene reflection qualitycl_avfx_contact_blood_scene_reflection_qualitySSR march precision. Higher values are crisper and cost more GPU time. Applies immediately. [Low / Medium / High / Ultra]
ToggleBlood-pool model reflectioncl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflectionColoured local model reflections clipped to actual horizontal blood footprints. At least one category below must be enabled. Applies immediately.
SliderModel reflection strengthcl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_strengthOpacity of coloured model reflections in blood. Applies immediately.
ListModel reflection qualitycl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_qualityControls receiver population and distance before model replay work. Applies immediately. [Performance / Medium / Quality / Ultra / Extra]
ToggleCategory: Pickup weaponscl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_weaponsAllow pickup weapons to reflect in blood pools. Applies immediately.
ToggleCategory: Armorcl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_armorAllow armor to reflect in blood pools. Applies immediately.
ToggleCategory: Itemscl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_itemsAllow items to reflect in blood pools. Applies immediately.
ToggleCategory: Players and monsterscl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_actorsAllow players and monsters to reflect in blood pools. Applies immediately.
ToggleCategory: Projectiles and rail beamcl_avfx_contact_blood_model_reflection_projectilesAllow projectiles and rail beam to reflect in blood pools. Applies immediately.
SliderReflection distortioncl_avfx_contact_blood_reflection_distortOptional moving-liquid distortion shared by blood SSR and model reflection. Applies immediately.
SliderDistortion speedcl_avfx_contact_blood_reflection_distort_speedTravel speed of reflection ripples; 0 freezes their animation. Applies immediately.

Budgets (q2prox_avfx_contact_budgets)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Local FX & Sound → Player Contact Effects → Budgets

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SliderTracked targetscl_avfx_contact_max_targetsHow many opponents keep their own wound, burst and reservoir state at once. The least recently hit target is dropped first. Applies immediately.
SliderAirborne dropletscl_avfx_contact_max_dropletsHard cap on visible blood droplets. The active quality tier may lower it further; it can never raise it. Applies immediately.
SliderCollision traces per framecl_avfx_contact_max_collision_probesHow many representative droplet trajectories may be traced against the world each frame. Untraced droplets render as satellites of a traced one. Applies immediately.
SliderWounds on modelscl_avfx_contact_max_model_marksHard cap on animated wounds across every target at once. Applies immediately.
SliderWorld blood markscl_avfx_contact_max_surface_bloodHard cap on blood stains, drips and pools present in the world. Applies immediately.
SliderWeapon markscl_avfx_contact_max_decalsHard cap on weapon impact marks present in the world. Applies immediately.
SliderVapor recordscl_avfx_contact_max_vaporHard cap on vaporization residue, smoke and shimmer records. Applies immediately.
SliderSurface debriscl_avfx_contact_max_debrisHard cap on airborne surface fragments across all weapon impacts. Applies immediately.

Player Contact Effects: info (q2prox_avfx_contact_info)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Preset Generator → AVFX Player Contact Presets → Player Contact Effects: info

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
SectionWhat this isWhat this is
NavigationWhat this isEffects from your own hitsecho Player Contact Effects: effects from your own weapon hits.Blood effects and weapon impact marks are configured independently. Weapon vaporization adds scorched residue, smoke and heat alongside blood; it never disables it.
SectionWhat it never doesWhat it never does
NavigationWhat it never doesPresentation onlyecho Player Contact Effects: presentation only.It changes nothing about the game itself: no server authority, no damage, no hit registration, no prediction, no demo format, no entity visibility and no networking. It works on ordinary Quake II and Q2PRO servers with no server mod, and it never shows your own blood from damage you took.
SectionPresetsPresets
NavigationPresetsSeparate from ordinary AVFX presetsecho Player Contact presets are independent of ordinary AVFX presets.Player Contact presets and ordinary AVFX presets are separate in both directions: loading one never changes the other. The 12 custom slots are global files shared by every mod.

Stones and rubble (q2prox_avfx_rubble)

Path: Main menu → Advanced Visual Effects → AVFX Detailed Settings → Surfaces & Water → Surface Objects → Stones and rubble

TypeSectionRowVariable or targetHint
ToggleEnabledcl_avfx_surface_rubbleIndependent Surface Objects category; requires only the common master. Decorative geometry, no collision. Applies immediately.
ListQualitycl_avfx_surface_rubble_qualityMesh detail. Fixed object positions and visibility never depend on quality. Applies immediately. [Performance / Balanced / High / Ultra]
SliderDensitycl_avfx_surface_rubble_densityStable map population. Placement rebuilds once when settings change, never when the camera moves. Applies immediately.
SliderSizecl_avfx_surface_rubble_sizeCluster size in world units. The complete footprint must fit its support, clear of openings and water. Applies immediately.

Command and menu help in Beta 5

All client variables and console commands have Russian and English help. Entering a variable name shows its value, description and accepted values. Entering a command without arguments prints its description and syntax below the input line; the command still executes normally. Commands from binds and configuration files do not print hints. Menu-button and key-binding technical hints explain what a command does rather than merely naming it.

The Commands tab adds groups for visual effects and presets; gameplay, HUD and timers; music and voice; network tools; menus, browsers and editors; local server and play; and commands for the separate OpenTDM-X mod. The current browser catalogue contains 519 commands: 78 previous and 441 added. Each has a description, syntax and an indication of its effects. Selecting one only inserts it into the console; it does not execute it. Internal commands are hidden from the browser but retain console and menu help. OpenTDM-X help does not mean the mod or a bot menu is included in the public client.
